AI.motivation: 当前云碳核算存在两种割裂的方法：自下而上指标（如SCI）可指导工程优化但忽略服务商侧开销，自上而下报告全面但粗糙且不透明。监管披露需要可问责的工作负载级信号，但若自下而上指标的成效无法在受审计的报告中体现，将难以被采纳用于大规模问责。论文旨在论证两种信号应当可调和（reconcilable），弥合优化与披露之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 方法包括：（1）调研50家云服务商披露现状，构建工程行动（如能效、硬件效率、碳感知时序/区域选择）与报告方法响应性的映射表；（2）形式化定义rSCI——在自下而上能耗估算基础上加上"残差"项（服务商报告总量减去自下而上估算），并证明各工作负载归因之和等于报告总量；（3）将残差按GHG Scope分解，再重新聚类为能量驱动（按运营排放比例分配）和容量驱动（按工作负载对峰值、冗余、延迟约束等的容量贡献分配）两类；（4）通过8×H100节点的LLM推理服务案例进行数值演示；（5）基于AWS、Azure、Scaleway实际账户诊断报告粒度不足、口径不透明、标准缺失三大落地障碍，并给出具体改进建议。
AI.result: 结果显示：（1）调研的11家通用计算云服务商中，无一家对所有碳减排行动一致响应；多数以使用小时数、规格价或收入为分配单位，无法反映降低利用率或迁移到清洁时段等行动。（2）rSCI在案例中通过构造性使各小时指标乘以token量之和精确等于服务商报告的100 kg；容量残差采用共享资源池峰值的平方加权规则，比均匀分配更能引导灵活负载向低峰时段迁移。（3）在AWS生产账户上，6个月内67–96%的排放被归入"Other"大类，缺乏资源级拆解；自下而上估算可能是报告值的2–5倍，产生负残差且无法区分模型误差与边界差异。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：rSCI为统一云碳核算提供了可操作的框架，能够保留运营激励并按物理驱动归因隐含碳和闲置容量；但当前云服务商披露过于粗糙、方法不透明、缺乏统一标准，尚不足以支撑可信的对账。未来工作包括在多云生产负载上评估rSCI、验证分配权重与激励、构建可复现的对账管线，以及基于历史报告与负载预测构建带不确定性的在线估算。论文最后向服务商和GHG Protocol提出了三项具体改进要求：发布每个可计费资源的排放数据、保证报告可复现可审计、制定云特定报告边界与分配规则的统一标准。

title: Efficient Heuristics and Machine Learning Approach for Fault Characterization in Distributed Self-Stabilizing Programs
summary: Modern large-scale systems rely on distributed protocols to maximize efficiency while preserving the correctness guarantees of single-process execution. However, designing such protocols is non-trivial: adding resources to a system inherently increases its complexity, which in turn introduces faults that must be addressed during design. One such fault class, arising in systems that use distributed shared memory (e.g., replicated databases), is consistency violating fault (cvf), a fault in which a process accessing shared memory reads stale data previously written by another process. Cvfs are inherent to systems that prioritize availability over strict consistency. Prior work has shown that self-stabilizing programs remain correct under high availability, provided such faults stay within a tolerable bound. Characterizing the behavior of self-stabilizing programs in the presence of cvfs can therefore help system designers build systems that are both correct and efficient. In this paper, we study self-stabilizing programs under cvfs to understand when and where such faults occur, enabling runtime measures that improve computational efficiency. Since exhaustive state-space exploration does not scale, it suffers from state-space explosion; our study investigates two complementary approaches: a conflict-based state-space exploration technique for monotonically stabilizing $({\Delta} + 1)$-Graph Coloring programs, and a machine-learning-based approach for a Maximal Independent Set program. We propose a conflicting-edges-based state-space exploration algorithm alongside a rigorously validated ML model, evaluated on an out-of-distribution dataset through structural consistency checks against known graph invariants.

AI.tldr: 针对分布式自稳定程序中一致性违反故障（cvf）的特征分析问题，提出两种互补的、可扩展的方法以规避状态空间爆炸：(1) 基于冲突边的状态空间探索算法（CE），专门用于单调稳定的 (Δ+1)-图着色程序；(2) 基于机器学习的方法，专门用于最大独立集（MIS）程序，使用GIN架构并通过多贪心高度特征和缩放残差学习实现对分布外（OOD）较大图的泛化。
AI.motivation: 分布式共享内存系统中的自稳定图程序在存在一致性违反故障（cvf）时仍能保持正确性，前提是故障在可容忍范围内。刻画此类程序在 cvf 下的行为（故障的"何时"和"何处"发生）对设计正确且高效的系统至关重要。然而，自稳定程序的配置空间随图规模呈指数增长（如10节点完全图约 10^9 状态），穷尽式状态空间探索存在状态空间爆炸问题，因此亟需可扩展的替代方法。
AI.method: 方法一：基于冲突边的状态空间探索（CE）。将单调稳定程序的配置空间映射为冲突边状态而非节点颜色配置；通过分支-消除合格节点以及对子图重新标注来枚举冲突边状态，附带缓存以避免重复计算；通过归纳证明其正确性（引理2.7）。方法二：基于机器学习的分析。构建三层次特征体系（节点特征、配置特征、图特征），采用图同构网络（GIN）作为主架构（辅以图卷积网络GCN对比），使用多贪心高度（multi-greedy height）作为Lyapunov上界，预测缩放残差 y = (lyap − rank) / scale，以实现跨图规模的权重共享与OOD泛化。训练集为3–8节点图，OOD验证集为9–13节点图，评估时外推至100节点图（3^100 状态空间）。
AI.result: 在 (Δ+1)-图着色上：CE 方法相比穷尽式FA在时间与内存上均更高效，内存优势在核心阶段尤为显著，且随图规模增长呈超线性扩大；缓存命中率随图规模超线性增长，星形图因高度对称命中率接近100%，幂律聚类图因结构异质性缓存缺失最多。在 MIS 上：完整模型（含8特征、GIN、深度3、隐藏维度96、平均池化）OOD MAE为0.2875；移除节点特征组后OOD MAE恶化至0.6567，验证节点特征对泛化最关键；消融实验表明较浅深度、较小隐藏维度和平均池化有利于OOD泛化。模型成功捕捉到：(1) 低秩配置倾向正秩效应、高秩配置倾向负秩效应（"何时"）；(2) 在顶点可迁的完全图上预测均匀、在星形图上区分枢纽与叶子、在路径图上差异微小，在幂律图上除聚类系数外三种中心性指标均显示高低值节点差异显著（"何处"）。预测秩效应随图规模缩放，但绝对精度因地面真值在3^100空间不可计算而未验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的两种互补方法有效规避了自稳定分布式程序cvf分析中的状态空间爆炸问题：CE方法利用单调稳定性质在结构上引导探索，ML方法通过多贪心高度与缩放残差实现对大型OOD图的泛化。ML模型能以可计算方式捕捉秩效应在多种属性（秩、节点中心性）极值间的相对分布模式。未来工作包括：研究OOD图上预测秩效应的绝对精度；将CE缓存与ML推理结合以进一步提升单调稳定程序的秩计算效率；将基于ML的方法扩展至MIS之外的其他自稳定程序。

title: LOCAA: An Agentic System for Automated Lossy Compressor Tuning
summary: Large-scale scientific simulations generate substantial data volumes, making lossy compression essential for reducing storage and data movement costs. However, users configure compressors through numerical error bounds (EBs) while often evaluating results using quality metrics and end-to-end performance. Because the relationship between an EB and these outcomes varies across datasets and compressors, identifying a suitable configuration typically requires exhaustive search, which can be time-consuming and computationally demanding. We present LOCAA, an Large language model-based scientific lossy compression auto-tuning agent that performs compression-in-the-loop search using tool-integrated execution, compressor-aware guidance, and persistent memory. LOCAA supports user-defined objectives and constraints without requiring a specialized search strategy. We evaluate LOCAA across three scientific applications, five compressors, and three use cases: fixed-ratio compression, compression tuning under multiple quality constraints, and compression tuning under quality and time constraints. For fixed-ratio search across twelve fields from two applications, LOCAA requires 1.98x fewer evaluation trials than binary search and 5.03x fewer than FRaZ on average. For compression ratio maximization under joint Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index Measure constraints across six fields from the Community Earth System Model application, LOCAA reduces the average evaluation trials from 61.5 using binary search to 17, corresponding to a 72.4% reduction. Persistent memory further reduces the average number of trials by 27.9% across multiple timesteps of the same field. These results demonstrate the potential of tool-augmented LLM agents to provide flexible and efficient compressor tuning across diverse scientific data and user-defined objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LOCAA，一个基于LLM的科学有损压缩自动调优代理系统，通过压缩内循环搜索、工具集成执行和持久记忆，实现高效的压缩器配置搜索。在多种科学数据集和压缩器上的评估表明，LOCAA显著减少了搜索所需的评估次数。
AI.motivation: 科学模拟产生海量数据，有损压缩需通过误差界(EB)配置，但EB与用户关心的质量指标(PSNR/SSIM)及端到端性能之间的关系是非线性且随数据集和压缩器变化的，传统搜索方法(二分搜索、FRaZ等)效率低且需要专用策略。
AI.method: LOCAA采用单代理架构，整合：(1)任务特定提示设计（含PSNR驱动的EB初始化和ZFP阶梯式响应感知）；(2)MCP协议暴露的工具接口（压缩执行、数据统计、记忆读写）；(3)持久记忆机制复用历史调优经验；(4)显式观察-解释-预测-行动的CoT推理循环。底层使用GPT-5.5和Pocket Agent框架。
AI.result: 在三个科学应用、五种压缩器、三种用例上的评估显示：(1)固定比例搜索平均仅需3.76次评估，比二分搜索减少1.98倍、比FRaZ减少5.03倍；(2)CESM上联合PSNR和SSIM约束下CR最大化，评估次数从61.5降至17，减少72.4%；(3)持久记忆在多时间步场景进一步减少27.9%的评估次数；(4)消融实验表明压缩器特定知识对ZFP提升最大(2.17倍加速)，CoT贡献13.1%的改进。
AI.conclusion: LOCAA验证了工具增强型LLM代理在科学压缩调优中的潜力，相比传统固定搜索策略，能以更少的评估次数灵活适应不同数据集、压缩器和用户定义的目标，为HPC工作流中的自主压缩调优开辟了新方向。未来工作包括扩展到更大规模数据集、更多压缩器、生产HPC环境以及跨数据集知识迁移机制。

title: Expert Coupling in MoE Pretraining: Reducing All-to-All Overhead with Correlated Placement and Token Shuffling
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers replace the feed-forward block of a Transformer with E expert networks, and each token is routed to k of these experts. Under expert parallelism (EP) the experts are distributed across GPUs, and every MoE layer runs all-to-all collectives in the forward and backward passes to dispatch tokens to their experts and then combine the results. On a cluster with 8 AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs per node, these collectives can take 45% of the training step at EP32 with top-2 routing and 60% with top-6 routing. We find that early in pretraining routers have already learned to assign tokens to experts in correlated patterns, both within a layer and across layers. At top-2, 0.8% of the expert pairs in a layer are selected together by 42% of tokens, and the experts a token selects at one layer predict the experts it selects at the next layer. We use these correlations to keep more token--expert assignments on the token's own GPU, which reduces communication across GPUs and across nodes. Correlated expert placement puts experts that are often selected together on the same GPU. Combined with a dispatcher that sends each token to each GPU once, it removes up to 58% of dispatched rows. Token shuffling applies when sequence parallelism shards tokens across the EP group. It moves each token to the GPU predicted to hold its next-layer experts during the reduce-scatter that follows attention. On one node this raises the share of token--expert assignments served on the token's GPU from 12.5% to 59%. In Megatron-LM, across EP degrees from 8 to 64 with top-2 and top-6 routing, the two methods reduce all-to-all time by 1.16-2.63X and end-to-end step time by up to 1.41X. Neither method changes the models' underlying routing decisions or expert parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MoE预训练中专家并行导致的全对全通信瓶颈，发现专家路由存在稳定的层内共选相关性和跨层预测性，并据此提出相关专家放置、去重分发器和令牌重排，在不改变路由、模型结构或专家参数的前提下降低通信。实验显示，在AMD MI300X集群上，全对全时间降低1.16–2.63倍，端到端训练步最高加速1.41倍。
AI.motivation: MoE层在专家并行下，每层前向和反向都需要执行分发与合并的全对全集体通信，通信量随专家并行度和top-k增加；在跨节点部署时，通信开销可占训练步的大多数。传统连续专家放置忽略了专家之间的路由相关性，导致总通信量和跨节点流量较高。论文旨在利用预训练早期即可形成的专家选择模式，在不修改路由决策、训练损失或专家参数的前提下提高token–expert局部性，从根本上减少网络通信总量，而非仅缓解通信不均衡。
AI.method: 方法分为两类。1）层内相关性：构建专家共选相关性图W，并采用Kernighan–Lin式局部搜索，将常被同一token共同选择的专家放入同一GPU；跨节点时先做节点间分组，再做节点内GPU分组。同时实现去重分发器，使每个token对每个目标GPU最多发送一次，并携带该GPU上相关专家ID和路由权重。2）跨层相关性：利用前两层MoE路由预测下一层token的专家所属GPU，在TP组与EP组相同的序列并行布局中，将令牌排列融合到注意力后的reduce-scatter中，使其提前移动到预测的owner rank；随后由MoE dispatch处理，并利用shuffle-aware all-gather恢复注意力所需的规范顺序。规划器在侧流中与专家计算和下一注意力层重叠执行。相关表由路由轨迹离线构建，约数千token即可稳定估计，并可随训练定期重拟合。
AI.result: 在一个12层、128专家的MoE模型上，top-2路由下约0.8%的专家对承载42%的token；128个专家中有73个至少与一个伙伴专家共同被选中30%以上的token。相关结构约在10亿token后形成，并在训练后期保持稳定。仅相关放置与去重分发器可减少最多58%的分发行；在EP8上，top-2和top-6的token–expert局部性分别提升至约53%和18%，token重排进一步在单节点将局部性从12.5%提升至59%。在EP8–64、top-2/top-6实验中，全对全通信时间降低1.16–2.63倍；端到端步时间最高加速1.41倍。增益在top-6、跨节点EP时最明显。方法不引入专家复制，也不改变模型路由行为或训练损失。
AI.conclusion: 专家路由的层内共选相关性和跨层可预测性是MoE预训练中可利用的通信优化信号。相关放置与去重分发器降低跨GPU和跨节点的全对全通信量；令牌重排进一步利用序列并行已有collective移动token，在几乎不增加通信的情况下提高下一层专家的局部性。该工作主要在EP及TP=EP布局、top-2/top-6和12层模型上验证，跨模型规模、其他并行布局（如上下文并行）以及EP推理仍待进一步研究。

title: Differential Refresh Policies for Models Trained on Lagging Data Snapshots: From a Single-Age Equivalence Limit to an Optimal Per-Segment Allocation
summary: Production machine-learning models are derived artifacts of time-bounded training snapshots: a deployed model is a materialized view over a training cut that ages the instant it is built. A common response is to replace the fixed retraining cadence with an adaptive trigger -- a weighted staleness score that retrains when accumulated source risk crosses a threshold. We show this is the wrong lever, and identify the right one. First, an equivalence limit: any refresh trigger that is a static, strictly monotone function of a single shared global training-data age is operationally equivalent to a calibrated uniform age timer, so a global staleness budget, however elaborately it weights segments, sources, and sensitivities, carries no scheduling information a clock does not. The limit also shows how to escape it: refresh segments differentially, giving each its own age and refresh interval, which is meaningful when refresh cost is separable across segments (incremental training or per-segment models). We solve the resulting budget-allocation problem. In the frequent-refresh regime each segment's optimal refresh rate is proportional to the square root of its risk $w_j \lambda_j$ (weight times change rate), and the optimal policy never costs more than the uniform timer, beating it by a closed-form Cauchy-Schwarz "price of uniformity" that is zero for homogeneous workloads and grows with heterogeneity. In a discrete-event simulation with real Poisson change events, the optimal policy lowers realized weighted stale exposure by 8-29% relative to the uniform timer at matched refresh budget, winning on 86-100% of seeds; a naive exposure-threshold policy does not, showing the allocation is what helps; and the advantage survives 50% rate-estimation noise. The leverage in model refresh is not a better score but a better action.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生产环境中机器学习模型的刷新策略，提出"单龄等价极限"定理，证明任何基于单一全局训练数据龄期的静态单调刷新触发器都等价于校准后的均匀定时器；同时给出最优差分刷新策略——在可分离成本假设下，频繁刷新区间内每段最优刷新率与其风险(权重×变化率)的平方根成正比，并通过Cauchy-Schwarz不等式量化"统一性代价"。仿真验证该策略在异构工作负载下比均匀定时器降低8-29%的加权陈旧暴露。
AI.motivation: 生产ML模型基于某一时间点的训练快照部署，随时间推移而老化。常见做法是用加权的"陈旧度分数"作为自适应触发器来替代固定刷新周期，但作者质疑这种触发器是否真的比简单的定时器提供额外信息，以及在能区分的情况下最优策略是什么。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：证明单龄等价极限(定理1)，通过拉格朗日乘子法求解最优分配(定理2)，利用Cauchy-Schwarz不等式推导"统一性代价"的封闭形式(定理3)。2) 模型建立：将训练群体划分为n个段，每段有权重w_j、变化率λ_j，采用Poisson暴露模型计算加权陈旧度，在刷新预算约束下最小化总成本。3) 离散事件仿真：使用真实Poisson变化事件，比较最优差分策略、均匀定时器、朴素暴露阈值策略在不同异构程度下的表现。
AI.result: 1) 理论结果：均匀定时器是最优的边界情形；平方根法则x_j* ∝ √(w_jλ_j)给出频繁刷新区间内的最优分配；统一性代价为零当且仅当工作负载同质。2) 仿真结果：最优差分策略在匹配刷新预算下比均匀定时器降低7.7-28.8%陈旧暴露，在86-100%的随机种子上获胜；朴素暴露阈值策略则接近持平或更差；策略对50%速率估计噪声仍保持优势。3) 封闭形式在频繁刷新区间内高度精确(误差<0.35%)，在稀疏区间退化。
AI.conclusion: 模型刷新的关键不在于更精细的评分机制，而在于更优的行动——按段风险的平方根分配刷新预算。该策略在理论保证(从不超过均匀定时器成本)和实证验证(8-29%节省)两方面均成立，优势随异构性增长，并对估计噪声具有鲁棒性。设计准则：若刷新成本可分离(增量训练或分段模型)，应采用差分刷新而非复杂的全局陈旧度评分。

title: Almost Optimal Constant-Round Approximation of Dominating Set in Graph Classes with Excluded Minors
summary: For every fixed proper minor-closed class $\mathscr C$ and every $\epsilon>0$, we give a deterministic LOCAL algorithm that returns a dominating set of size at most $(2a(\mathscr C)+1+\epsilon)\gamma_f(G)$ on every $G\in\mathscr C$. Here $a(\mathscr C)$ is the supremum edge-to-vertex ratio in~$\mathscr C$, and $\gamma_f(G)$ is the fractional domination number. The class also admits a deterministic $(1+\epsilon)$-approximation for fractional dominating set and a randomized algorithm that always returns a dominating set and has expected size at most $(1+\epsilon)\gamma(G)$. In each case, the number of rounds depends only on $\mathscr C$ and~$\epsilon$. None of these algorithms requires the number of vertices or the maximum degree as part of the input. For planar graphs, this gives the deterministic guarantee $(7+\epsilon)\gamma_f(G)$. Together with the lower bound of Hilke, Lenzen and Suomela, it determines the infimum of the deterministic constant-round approximation ratios for planar minimum dominating set as~$7$, settling a question that had remained open since their work. The corresponding infima, measured against the integral optimum, are $7$ for graphs of Euler genus at most any fixed $g\ge0$, $2t-3$ for $K_t$-minor-free graphs with $3\le t\le9$, and $2r+1$ for graphs of treewidth or pathwidth at most any fixed $r\ge1$. We also prove that, for every integer~\mbox{$r\ge1$}, no deterministic constant-round LOCAL algorithm achieves an approximation ratio below~\mbox{$2r+1$} on the $r$-th powers of paths, even when every vertex knows the number of vertices. This gives a new proof that the limiting constants are optimal for planar graphs, graphs of bounded treewidth or pathwidth, and $K_t$-minor-free graphs with $3\le t\le9$. For triangle-free planar graphs, the corresponding infimum is $5$.

AI.tldr: 本文针对任何固定的正常小闭图类，给出了确定性和随机的常平图（LOCAL）模型下近乎最优的常数轮支配集逼近算法，将平面图等图类的确定性常轮逼近比下界与上界之间的长期间隙彻底闭合，确立了平面图常轮最小支配集逼近比的下确界为 7。
AI.motivation: 确定常数轮 LOCAL 算法对最小支配集问题在稀疏图类（尤其是平面图）中的最佳逼近比一直是分布式计算领域的核心问题。先前的最优上界为 8+ε（针对分数最优）与 25+ε（针对固定 Euler 亏格），而下界已证明任何常数轮算法的逼近比不低于 7（平面图情形，源自 Hilke、Lenzen 和 Suomela 的三角网格构造）。如何消除这一间隙，特别是对于任意排除小图类，给出与密度相关的精确常数并证明其最优性，是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: 方法融合四类已知技术：(1) 基于星收缩的随机聚类算法（扩展自 Czygrinow-Hańćkowiak-Wawrzyniak 的伪森林方法），用每部分一枚公平硬币代替依赖顶点数的 coloring 步骤；(2) 分数定向引理（基于 LP 对偶和 Charikar 最密子图刻画）将 a-稀疏图的出度控制在 a 以内，用于阈值舍入分析；(4) Kuhn 分布式线性规划的确定性化原理，将随机算法每个输出坐标替换为其期望值，得到 (1+ε) 倍分数逼近并再加一轮阈值舍入得到整数支配集。还引入了渐近密度 d*(C) 与加性冗余 Φ_d(G) 的概念处理亏格类中"超额边数有界"的情形；下界部分使用路径幂 P_n^r 的 Ramsey 论证。
AI.result: 主要结果：对每个正常小闭图类 C 和 ε>0：(a) 随机 LOCAL 算法在 O_{C,ε}(1) 轮内返回支配集，期望大小 ≤ (1+ε)γ(G)；(b) 确定性算法返回权重 ≤ (1+ε)γ_f(G) 的分数支配集；(c) 确定性算法返回大小 ≤ (2a(C)+1+ε)γ_f(G) 的支配集，无需 |V| 或最大度作为输入。推论：平面图情形逼近比为 (7+ε)γ_f(G)；Euler 亏格 ≤ g 图类获 (7+ε)γ(G)（亏格独立）；K_t-排除小图（3≤t≤9）获 (2t-3+ε)γ_f(G)；树宽/路径宽 ≤ r 图获 (2r+1+ε)γ_f(G)；无三角形平面图获 (5+ε)γ_f(G)。下界：第 r 次幂路径 P_n^r 上任何常数轮算法的逼近比不低于 2r+1，证明上述常数均为最优下确界（包括平面图 7 的情形）。
AI.conclusion: 本文彻底解决了 Hilke-Lenzen-Suomela 遗留的开放问题，确定了平面图常数轮最小支配集逼近的下确界为 7，并将其推广到所有排除小图类、有界亏格、有界树宽/路径宽等广泛图类，获得与图类密度相关的紧致逼近比。技术贡献包括：将分数聚类解直接与全局分数最优比较的分析、考虑加性密度冗余的舍入引理，以及基于路径幂的新下界证明。遗留问题包括：精确比 7 是否可达（而非 7+ε）、K_t-排除小图（t≥10）下确界的精确值、常数轮 CONGEST 模型中 (7+ε)-逼近是否可行、匿名网络的最优比例等。

title: Mitigating Uncertainty Interactions in GenAI-based Adaptive Systems: Vision, Challenges and Preliminary Guidelines
comment: The work has been accepted and published in ACSOS 2026
summary: Modern software-intensive systems increasingly incorporate GenAI components, including LLM and agentic subsystems, which introduce novel and compounding sources of uncertainty across system layers. The self-adaptive systems community has made significant strides in understanding and managing uncertainty. The intrinsic characteristics of GenAI, including probabilistic outputs, hallucinations, context window limitations, and memory staleness, demand a re-examination of existing frameworks and mitigation strategies for dealing with uncertainty, and especially, the interactions among uncertainty occurrences and manifestations. This position paper posits an initial conceptual framework that establishes preliminary guidelines for characterizing and mitigating uncertainty interactions in GenAI-based software-intensive systems. We argue that mitigation must be considered across the full software lifecycle, encompassing requirements analysis, design-time decisions, and run-time adaptations, which implies the unfeasibility of decoupling it from monitoring and analysis at execution. We introduce the notion of a mitigation function that maps uncertainty interaction categories, involved uncertainty types, system design characteristics, criticality, and mitigating architectural tactics to impacted quality attributes and corresponding tradeoffs. As a proof of concept, we apply the framework to three illustrative use cases: LLM serving, AI-driven software operations, and agentic cloud management.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文（position paper），提出了一个针对GenAI自适应系统中不确定性交互的初步概念框架。其核心贡献是引入"缓解函数"（mitigation function）作为统一抽象，将不确定性交互类别、不确定性类型、系统设计特征、关键性向量、质量属性和架构策略映射到相应的权衡结果。通过LLM服务、智能云运维（CloudOps）和AIOps数字孪生三个用例验证了框架的适用性，并提出了五大研究挑战与分阶段研究路线图。
AI.motivation: GenAI组件（如LLM和智能体子系统）正被集成到软件密集型系统中，引入了概率性输出、幻觉、上下文窗口限制、记忆陈旧等新型不确定性。这些不确定性并非孤立存在，而是在系统各层间交互传播（dominance、augmentation、conflict、independence），产生传统自适应系统框架难以推理的涌现行为。现有针对不确定性的自适系统框架无法充分应对GenAI特有的内在不确定性，亟需新的抽象来连接不确定性推理与架构决策。
AI.method:
1. 提出"缓解函数"的形式化定义：输入包括交互类别（IC）、不确定性类型（Types）、系统设计（Design）、关键性向量（Cr）、质量属性（Q）和策略（Tactics），输出为保证的质量属性与所选策略的元组。
2. 策略（tactic）被建模为三元组⟨机制、范围（组件/子系统/系统/生态）、生命周期（设计时/部署时/运行时）⟩。
3. 引入权衡剖面（trade-off profile）概念：Q+（保证提升）与Q-（可能退化），并提出合成策略的涌现效应公式。
4. 通过三个代表性用例（UC1: LLM SLO合规、UC2: 智能体CloudOps、UC3: AIOps数字孪生）实例化框架，每个用提供3-4个具体策略及其权衡分析。
5. 提出从策略catalog演进到"不确定性缓解模式"的构想，将策略组合封装为可复用模式。
6. 识别五大研究挑战：交互特征化、策略选择指导、跨层架构复杂性、权衡评估、动态上下文管理。
AI.result:
1. 框架成功形式化了三种不确定性交互模式：UC1为augmentation（工作量与输出不确定性相互放大）、UC2和UC3为dominance（一个源系统性地主导另一源）。
2. 三个用例揭示了关键模式：QoS与成本的普遍权衡、交互类别决定策略设计、托管系统与管理系统的区分、运行时策略占主导（除合成数据生成这种设计时策略外）。
3. 识别出三种策略交互模式：协同（synergy，如UC1中预测+调度）、冲突（conflict，如UC2中知识增强与层次摘要可能互相抵消）、使能（enablement，如UC3中合成数据使能集成模型多样性）。
4. 提出了三个初步缓解模式雏形：Predictive Batch Orchestration、Memory-Aware Agent、Robust AIOps Predictor。
5. 提出了分阶段研究路线图：近期（概念基础）→中期（架构集成与缓解模式）→长期（严格评估与自适应缓解机制）。
AI.conclusion: GenAI基础的软件密集型系统引入了质的全新的不确定性形式及其交互，需要新型缓解方法。本文提出的不确定性交互形式化将架构策略作为显式输入，使从不确定性交互到质量属性结果的映射变得可操作化。三个用例证明了该框架能够支撑关于权衡、策略组合和缓解模式的原理性推理。论文为研究社区指出了未来方向：需建立GenAI特有的不确定性分类法、架构感知表示、不确定性感知设计策略、运行时自适应缓解机制，以及严格的评估框架。最终目标是实现透明可控的自适应GenAI系统，在运行时响应涌现的不确定性交互。

title: Psychological Safety in Software Engineering Teams: A Systematic Mapping Study of Team Processes and Performance
summary: Context: Psychological safety is an important human and behavioral factor in software development teams, supporting collaboration, knowledge sharing, interpersonal risk-taking, and learning. However, evidence in software engineering remains fragmented across team processes, performance outcomes, contextual conditions, barriers. Objective: This study maps literature on psychological safety in software engineering, examining its conceptualization, associations with team performance and processes, contextual influences, barriers, and strengthening strategies. Method: We conducted a systematic mapping study following established software engineering guidelines. We analyzed 112 primary studies published between 2006 and June 2026 using descriptive statistics and thematic analysis across six research questions. Results: Psychological safety emerges as a multidimensional, context-dependent, team-level construct characterized by interpersonal risk-taking, open communication, collaboration, learning, trust, and supportive interaction. It is predominantly associated with productivity, software quality, innovation, team satisfaction, collaboration, communication, and decision-making. These relationships are shaped by leadership, organizational culture, work environment, trust, and sociocultural and individual conditions. Recurring barriers include communication problems, organizational constraints, leadership issues, diversity and inclusion challenges, and workload pressures. Although diverse practices are reported, evidence of their effectiveness and long-term sustainability remains limited. Conclusion: Psychological safety is a multidimensional, context-dependent team-level construct associated with team interaction and performance. This study highlights the need for longitudinal, context-sensitive research on psychological safety interventions in software development environments.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇系统映射研究（SMS），分析了2006至2026年间112项关于软件工程团队心理安全（Psychological Safety）的实证研究，将其概念化为多维度、情境依赖的团队层面构念，考察其与团队绩效（生产力、软件质量、创新、满意度）、团队过程（协作、沟通、决策）、情境影响因素（领导力、文化、工作环境、信任等）、障碍及干预策略的关联，并指出未来需加强纵向、情境敏感的研究。
AI.motivation: 心理安全在软件开发中对协作、知识共享与学习至关重要，但现有软件工程领域证据分散于不同团队过程、绩效结果、情境条件、障碍和强化策略中，缺乏统一整合视角。作者旨在通过系统映射研究填补这一空白，为研究与实践提供结构化基础。
AI.method: 遵循软件工程系统研究指南，采用系统映射研究方法。检索五个数字图书馆（IEEE、ACM、ScienceDirect、SpringerLink、Wiley），结合滚雪球法，最终纳入112篇2006—2026年的原始研究。通过Cohen's Kappa评估筛选一致性（κ=0.68–0.77），进行质量评估（QA1–QA5），使用描述性统计和六步主题分析（数据熟悉化→初始编码→编码精炼→子主题→主题→审查与定义）回答六个研究问题（RQ1–RQ6）。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1)心理安全通过人际冒险、开放沟通、协作、学习、信任和支持性互动等7个主题25个子主题被概念化为多维度情境依赖构念；(2)主要与生产力（67篇）、软件质量（25篇）、创新（33篇）、团队满意度（34篇）相关；(3)通过协作（53篇）、沟通（41篇）、决策（17篇）发挥作用；(4)受领导力（56篇）、文化（35篇）、工作环境（62篇）、信任（30篇）等调节，其中领导力的支持性、包容性、变革性、赋能型风格强化心理安全，而层级权力结构与负面领导行为削弱之；(5)主要障碍包括沟通与信息流障碍、文化与人际信任挑战、结构与组织障碍、领导与管理问题、多样性与包容性障碍、工作负荷压力与资源约束；(6)干预策略涵盖领导力与组织实践、敏捷/角色/流程实践、学习反馈与能力建设、信任归属实践、幸福感压力与技术实践，但有效性与长期可持续性证据有限。
AI.conclusion: 心理安全是软件工程中多维度、情境依赖的团队层面构念，与团队过程和绩效密切相关。其与绩效的关系受领导力、文化、工作环境、信任及社会文化与个体条件调节。研究呼吁未来采用纵向、情境敏感的方法，考察心理安全干预在不同软件开发环境中的有效性、可持续性，尤其需要关注决策制定、多样性与包容性、虚拟分布式团队、AI支持协作等领域，并加强标准化测量框架。

title: Evaluating Change Point Detection Methods for Software Performance Regression Analysis
summary: Performance issues in software systems are a critical quality issue that can erode user trust, violate service-level agreements, and ultimately affect business efficiency. Consequently, software performance engineering has shifted its focus to developing robust techniques to detect performance regressions as early as possible in the development cycle. Performance regression analysis often relies on time series of performance measurements to detect significant changes in performance behavior. Change Point Detection (CPD) methods have been widely used to automate the identification of such changes in various domains, including finance, healthcare, and performance monitoring. However, the effectiveness of these methods for software performance measurements has not been thoroughly evaluated. In this paper, we present a comprehensive study to evaluate the effectiveness of various CPD methods on real-world software performance measurement datasets. We start by collecting performance measurement data from three large software systems and characterizing the unique properties of performance time series data. Then, we undertake a large-scale effort to annotate and evaluate the consistency of human annotators' identification of potential performance changes. Thereafter, we evaluate the accuracy of twelve distinct CPD methods in detecting potential performance changes, providing insights into their applicability and effectiveness in software performance regression analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文针对软件性能回归分析中的变点检测（CPD）方法开展了大规模实证评估。研究基于三个工业级系统（GraalVM、MongoDB、SAP HANA）的性能时序数据，刻画了性能时序区别于其他领域的统计特征，并通过14位专家对1500条时序的人工标注建立了基准真值，最终系统比较了12种CPD算法在默认参数与Oracle调优下的精度、召回率与F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有性能回归检测高度依赖CPD方法（尤其是E-Divisive Means），但缺乏对多种CPD算法在真实软件性能数据上的系统性比较，且对性能时序的统计特性知之甚少；同时，人工专家标注的一致性也未得到充分评估。本文旨在填补这些空白。
AI.method: 1) 从GraalVM、MongoDB、SAP HANA采集并清洗性能时序，统一为时间/吞吐指标并过滤短序列与异常值；2) 用变异系数、偏度、峰度、趋势、平稳性、自相关等指标刻画性能时序，并与Libra基准的经济、金融、人类活动、自然等领域对比；3) 基于AnnotateChange工具扩展，由14位性能工程专家对1500条时序进行分层抽样标注，计算OvR F1一致性；4) 评估12种CPD算法（AMOC、BINSEG、BOCPD、CPNP、ECP、KCPA、MONGO、PELT、PROPHET、RFPOP、SEGNEIGH、WBS）在默认与Oracle网格搜索参数下的精度/召回率/F1，并采用随机森林分析时序特征对CPD准确率的影响。
AI.result: 1) 性能时序相比其他领域具有更低的方差、更弱的趋势但更频繁的极值（高峰度），且自相关性较低；2) 专家标注整体一致性高（平均OvR F1≈0.87，中位数0.93，74%序列>0.8），但随共识阈值提高，共享变点数量显著下降，仍存在主观性；3) CPD效果因数据集而异：GraalVM平均F1=0.84，MongoDB=0.67，SAP HANA=0.65；Oracle调优后整体平均F1从0.70提升至0.90（增幅28%），主要因精度大幅提升；4) BINSEG在所有数据集与配置下表现最稳定且最佳（整体F1=0.87默认/0.97 Oracle），MONGO开箱即用表现强但调优空间有限，BOCPD与SEGNEIGH经调优后性能可比BINSEG；5) 序列长度是最重要的预测特征，自相关、偏度、峰度次之。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明CPD方法能在明确假设下近似专家识别性能变化的能力，但其有效性严重依赖数据集特性与超参数配置。简单的分割方法（如BINSEG）是稳健的默认选择；性能时序独特的统计特性意味着为其他领域设计的CPD方法需针对软件性能场景重新调整；专家标注具有主观性，应作为优先排序工具而非完全自动化方案。未来工作应关注基准的周期性再评估、按基准特性调优CPD、以及代价敏感的评价指标。

title: Large-scale Repository Engineering via Agent-Native Reusable Code Primitives
summary: Large language models equipped with development environments have moved code generation toward repository-scale construction, yet building complete repositories remains difficult because interacting modules, interfaces, configurations, tests, and dependencies must work together. We introduce Code Primitives, agent-native reusable executable components with interface contracts, dependency closures, validation tests, and provenance. Each primitive uses a resident LLM to assess relevance and adapt its implementation, interfaces, and dependencies to the target repository, and we organize 1,424 validated primitives in CodeFace, a searchable library for repository construction. We introduce LEGO (Large-scale repository Engineering via aGent-native reusable cOde primitives), which activates task-relevant primitives, integrates their adapted implementations with task-specific code while resolving cross-component constraints, and revises the result against executed tests. To measure construction end to end, we build LEGO-REPO, a benchmark of 522 executable reconstruction tasks spanning seven software domains, 22 capability tracks, and five difficulty levels, scored against native test suites between an empty-package floor and original-source ceiling. The strongest of 13 evaluated backbones reaches a delivery score of 0.318 and scores zero on 41.0% of tasks; LEGO improves all 13 by 0.1474 on average and raises GPT-5.6-terra from 0.3180 to 0.5134 (+61.4%). In controlled comparisons, adapted primitives outperform retrieved code supplied as context or vendored unchanged. The effect persists against independent repository agents, across three external benchmarks, and with a disjointly re-mined CodeFace; GPT-OSS-20B for adaptation and diagnosis retains 95.1% of the homogeneous score at 24.0% lower cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Code Primitives（具有接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试和来源信息的代理原生可重用代码组件）及包含1,424个验证组件的CodeFace库，并构建LEGO框架以在仓库构建中检索、适配并验证这些组件。LEGO-REPO基准（522个任务）显示LEGO使GPT-5.6-terra的交付分数从0.3180提升至0.5134（+61.4%），并在全部13个评估骨干上平均提升0.1474，验证了"通过适配而非调用来实现代码复用"的范式。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在仓库级代码生成上面临巨大挑战：从零构建完整仓库需要协调模块、接口、配置、测试和依赖，而现有研究表明即便最强的模型在仓库重建任务中也只能达到约0.318的交付分数（满分0），且41%任务得零分。已有可复用方法要么作为上下文提供、要么以调用方式复用，但都无法将复用的工件融入交付的源代码并适配目标仓库的接口与依赖。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三个层面：(1) Code Primitives——具有实现、接口契约、依赖闭包、验证测试和支持上下文的可执行组件，通过常驻LLM作为自然语言接口进行相关性评估和自适应适配；(2) CodeFace——包含1,424个验证组件（871个挖掘、343个收集、210个网络来源）的可搜索库；(3) LEGO框架——通过检索激活、原始协作（跨组件传播接口和依赖需求）、执行反馈与诊断验证的三阶段循环来协调组件。LEGO-REPO基准包含7个领域、22个能力轨道和5个难度级别的522个任务，使用空包下限和原始源码上限之间的原始库与本地测试套件评分。
AI.result: 主要结果：LEGO将GPT-5.6-terra从0.3180提升至0.5134（+61.4%），13个骨干平均提升0.1474；原始组件构建与适配贡献82.2%的增益；D5（最大仓库）相对增益达+162.0%；适配后的组件优于仅作上下文检索的代码（+0.1590）和未修改调用的代码（+0.1704）；在RepoZero、RepoGenesis、RepoCraft三个外部基准上分别提升16.9%、17.6%和14.9%；使用GPT-OSS-20B做适配和诊断可保留95.1%分数且降低成本24.0%；无关重新挖掘的CodeFace仍带来+0.1348的增益。
AI.conclusion: 仓库规模的代码生成应从反复重建软件能力转向积累、适配和重用这些能力。LEGO通过将复用范式从"调用"转变为"适配"，使每个原始组件成为交付仓库的一部分，能修改自身以适应目标接口和依赖。该框架对骨干选择具有鲁棒性，在模型替换和语料不相关库下效果持续存在，且支持高效的模型分配，为仓库级代码生成提供了新的范式。

title: Who Broke Me? Execution-Guided Repair of Behavioral Dependency Breaks
summary: Dependency upgrades can break downstream projects without changing the library interface. Such behavioral breaking changes are difficult for developers to fix, because the failing test does not always point to the root API, the upstream API that causes the break. Existing LLM-based repair methods obtain evidence for the repair from compiler feedback or library documentation. However, a behavioral break produces no compiler feedback and is often undocumented. Agents that receive no upgrade evidence also usually do not retrieve upstream evidence themselves, and most of their failed repairs do not identify the root API. The library diff provides useful upstream evidence, but the root API must first be identified to select the relevant part of the diff. We present BBCFixer, a repair method that runs the failing test under the old and new library versions, ranks the calls whose return value differs to identify a candidate root API, and filters the library diff with that candidate. To evaluate repairs of behavioral breaks, we further introduce BBCBench, a benchmark of 100 behavioral dependency breaks in Python and JavaScript. We compare BBCFixer on BBCBench with two baselines: (1) Pure Agent, an agent that receives no upgrade evidence, and (2) BDUpdater, a method that mines library documentation. BBCFixer raises the average pass rate by up to 17% relative to Pure Agent and needs up to 27% fewer agent steps per successful repair. BBCFixer thus provides a way to select the upstream evidence behind a behavioral break, so that an LLM agent can repair behavioral breaking changes more effectively and efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BBCFixer，一种通过差异执行（differential execution）自动选择上游证据来修复行为破坏性依赖变更（behavioral breaking changes）的方法，并构建了包含 100 个 Python 和 JavaScript 真实案例的基准 BBCBench。BBCFixer 在新旧库版本下运行失败测试，对返回值发生变化的调用进行排序以识别候选根 API（root API），并用该候选过滤库 diff，将紧凑的、针对失败特定的证据提供给 LLM 修复代理。实验表明，BBCFixer 相比 Pure Agent 平均通过率提升最高 17%，且每次成功修复所需代理步骤数减少最高 27%。
AI.motivation: 行为破坏性变更（接口不变但运行时行为变化）难以诊断和修复：失败测试的错误信息通常不指向导致问题的上游 API，而现有基于 LLM 的修复方法依赖编译错误反馈或库文档，但行为破坏既不产生编译错误，也常常未被文档化（仅约 27.7% 被记录）。无升级证据的智能体（Pure Agent）很少主动检索上游信息，其失败案例中约 67-69% 未能识别根 API，导致诊断阶段是主要失败模式。核心动机是解决"证据选择鸿沟"（evidence-selection gap）——失败出现在下游测试，而解释却在上游版本历史中。
AI.method: BBCFixer 包含三个阶段：（1）差异执行：在旧版和升级版库下分别运行失败测试，记录所有从外部进入库的调用及其参数和返回值，对齐两次执行的调用并比较返回值差异，按"调用来源是否在下游代码、是否在失败堆栈中、执行顺序"等规则对差异排序，最高排名的差异（first divergence）对应的 API 即候选根 API；（2）库 diff 过滤：以候选根 API 和从错误信息中提取的症状符号（异常名、断言值、堆栈中的库帧）为过滤键，从库 diff 中保留相关片段（库测试片段权重是源码片段的两倍）；（3）证据引导修复：将 first divergence 和过滤后的库 diff 作为只读文件挂载到代理容器，在初始 prompt 中呈现 first divergence 及按症状符号打分筛选的 diff 片段，代理基于这些证据修复下游代码。
AI.result: 在 BBCBench（100 个 Python/JS 案例）上对比 Pure Agent、BDUpdater 和 BBCFixer，使用 qwen3-coder 和 GLM-4.5-Air 两个模型各跑三轮：BBCFixer 在平均通过率上比 Pure Agent 最高提升 17%（qwen3-coder: 58.0% vs 49.7%；GLM-4.5-Air: 67.3% vs 60.0%），所有三轮中均优于两基线；每次成功修复所需代理步骤比 Pure Agent 少 15-27%，比 BDUpdater 少 29-58%，成本比 BDUpdater 少 27-58%；消融实验表明 first divergence 和过滤后库 diff 两者均必要；BBCFixer 根 API 识别率比 Pure Agent 高 22%，识别根 API 的运行通过率显著更高（高 52-251%）；在 51 个证据指向标注根 API 的案例上增益更大（qwen3-coder 20% vs 17%）。Pure Agent 在 qwen3-coder 61.3%、GLM-4.5-Air 83.0% 的运行中既不查询文本也不查询代码层面的上游信息。
AI.conclusion: 行为破坏性变更的修复本质上是一个证据选择问题，仅凭仓库访问不能让 LLM 代理获取所需的上游证据。BBCFixer 通过差异执行将下游失败转化为紧凑的上游修复证据，使代理能将步骤用于修复本身而非证据搜索，从而更有效、更高效地修复行为破坏。证据应展示根 API 行为的新旧对比而非仅其名称；该方法适合集成到 CI 流程中。论文同时指出未来方向：捕获通过测试运行器模块加载器或包装器的调用、改进排序规则、扩展记录器以覆盖操作符和属性读取等不回返回值的变更。

title: Beyond FAIR: A Fitness Function Framework for Sustainable Research Software
summary: Research software sustainability is often assessed through the FAIR principles: findability, accessibility, interoperability and reusability. While important, FAIR does not cover all relevant sustainability concerns. Research software should also be environmentally responsible and secure over time. Excessive resource consumption increases environmental cost, while insecure software creates maintenance overhead, technical debt and barriers to reuse. To this end, in this paper, we extend a previously proposed fitness function framework for sustainable research software beyond FAIR. We introduce two additional sets of fitness functions: environmental functions targeting resource efficiency and execution footprint, and security functions targeting dependency health, vulnerability exposure and secure configuration. Together, these functions broaden continuous software assessment from FAIR compliance to a more complete view of sustainability. The resulting framework treats research software sustainability as a multidimensional property that includes FAIR, environmental responsibility and long-term security.

AI.tldr: 该论文扩展了已有的FAIR（可发现性、可访问性、互操作性、可重用性）健身函数框架，新增了8个原子化健身函数（4个环境维度+4个安全维度），将研究软件可持续性评估从单一FAIR合规拓展为多维度可自动执行的持续评估机制。
AI.motivation: 研究软件的可持续性目前主要通过FAIR原则评估，但FAIR无法覆盖环境责任与长期安全等关键维度。过度资源消耗增加环境成本，不安全软件产生技术债务并阻碍复用，亟需一个多维度、可自动化执行的扩展框架。
AI.method: 遵循设计科学研究（DSR）范式，基于Zech & Pekaric (2026)的健身函数框架进行扩展。首先在FAIR之外征询出8项额外可持续需求（E1-E4环境、S1-S4安全），然后使用集合论符号为每项需求定义一个原子化、实现无关的健身函数（输入为工件A或工件+基准/环境，输出布尔值），并基于Python实现原型对HICSS工件及多个知名Python项目进行实证评估。
AI.result: 在HICSS工件上，环境维度中资源效率（10.79MB峰值内存，0.42秒执行）、基础足迹透明度、基础设施感知通过，但重计算避免失败；安全维度中依赖健康、安全配置、完整性/出处通过，但可维护安全姿态失败（缺少安全策略、CI工作流等）。对scikit-learn、pandas、NumPy等知名项目的评估显示，多数因缺少显式安全策略（SECURITY.md）而安全配置失败。该框架能有效揭示FAIR无法发现的可持续性缺口。
AI.conclusion: 研究软件可持续性应被视为多维属性，FAIR合规之外还应包含环境责任与长期安全。所提出的8项原子化健身函数以轻量级、模块化、可本地执行的方式使这些属性可测量、可操作。未来工作将聚焦可配置基准、领域阈值、成熟度级别、跨生态系统支持及模型驱动的工具链（如基于SAFT-GT的代码生成）。

title: GRAML: Graph-Grounded Reasoning and Multi-Task Learning for LLM-Based Software Vulnerability Detection
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely applied to software vulnerability detection. However, their performance is often limited by insufficient use of control-flow and data-flow information. In this paper, we propose GRAML, a framework that combines graph evidence, vulnerability description generation, and multi-task training. GRAML first performs static analysis on C/C++ programs to extract critical source lines and typed line relations as structural evidence. It then uses this evidence to guide GPT-5 through the Tree-of-Thought-guided Vulnerability Reasoning (ToT-VR) process and generate vulnerability descriptions. These descriptions are further combined with Detection, Localization, and Assessment samples to build a unified four-task training dataset. We evaluate GRAML on an in-distribution (ID) test set and six out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. The results show that GRAML achieves average F1 scores ranging from 66.67% to 68.70%, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by up to 30.92%. Ablation experiments further show that ToT-VR and graph-guided vulnerability descriptions improve detection performance compared with standard Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and raw Code Property Graph (CPG) serializations. These findings provide practical guidance for building more reliable and secure software engineering systems with large language models.

AI.tldr: GRAML是一个将CPG图结构证据、ToT-VR推理和多任务微调相结合的LLM软件漏洞检测框架，通过将控制流/数据流信息转化为自然语言监督信号，显著提升了检测性能和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在漏洞检测中对控制流和数据流信息利用不足，导致对漏洞根因的理解有限，易产生误报和漏报。如何将程序结构信息有效整合到LLM检测中仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 提出四模块框架：(1)基于Joern的CPG图结构上下文提取（行级DDG/CDG/CFG关系矩阵+可靠性感知的关键行选择）；(2)五阶段ToT-VR（分支初始化→反思剪枝→结构精化→CVE验证→描述合成）生成漏洞自然语言描述；(3)四任务统一微调（检测/描述/定位/评估）；(4)基于logit的推理方案。模型包括CodeLlama-7B、Mistral-7B、DeepSeek-6.7B和Qwen-7B，使用QLoRA（r=32）微调。
AI.result: 在1个ID测试集和6个OOD数据集上，平均F1分数达66.67%-68.70%，比最优基线提升高达30.92%。消融实验表明：ToT-VR相比CoT平均提升3.14%；自然语言描述监督优于原始CPG序列化（提升约1-2%）；移除图证据导致性能下降1-3%；Description任务贡献最大（移除后CodeLlama和Mistral分别下降4.53%和10.70%）。在7种语义保持代码变换（混淆/噪声/重构）下仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 将图结构证据转化为自然语言监督信号比直接使用CPG序列化或纯文本更有效；ToT-VR多分支探索机制比线性CoT能提供更准确的描述监督；多任务联合学习（特别是Description任务）显著提升检测性能。GRAML为构建基于LLM的可靠软件漏洞检测系统提供了实用指导。未来工作将扩展至多语言、更多静态分析工具集成以及自动化程序修复。

title: A Chat Assistant for Software Exploration in a 3D Software Visualization
summary: We present a chat assistant for interactive software exploration, embedded in the 3D software visualization tool ExplorViz. The assistant builds upon current Large Language Models (LLMs) and enables users to ask questions about the currently visualized software system and trigger actions that change the visualization through natural language. We integrate the chat assistant in our ExplorViz frontend using the CopilotKit libraries such that probabilistic LLMs are combined with deterministic and tool-based actions similar to implementations using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The chat assistant is also enabled to restructure the software system by adding, removing, or modifying parts of the software system in the visualization. An empirical experiment with eleven participants evaluated both perceived comprehension support and the tool calls that were triggered by the chat assistant. Participants rated the assistant's generated summaries and explanations as largely correct. They also reported high usability for actions like highlighting entities in the visualization and the creation of new color themes. In contrast, open-ended chat-assisted software restructuring in the visualization showed mixed results. This suggests a need for stronger guardrails for the employed LLM and better incorporation of user feedback. Overall, the assistant was perceived as usable and promising for reducing interaction overhead during exploratory program comprehension tasks. We provide a video presenting the chat assistant's use and a reproduction package of the software system that was used in our evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成在ExplorViz（基于城市隐喻的3D软件可视化工具）中的聊天助手，利用大语言模型（LLM）让用户通过自然语言提问并触发可视化操作（如高亮、相机聚焦、主题配置、软件重构等）。通过CopilotKit将概率性LLM与确定性前端工具调用结合（类似MCP协议），并通过11名参与者的实证评估验证其可用性。
AI.motivation: 传统3D软件可视化工具的交互方式繁琐且耗时，而现有LLM在软件可视化领域的应用多集中于2D场景。研究者希望探索基于自然语言的LLM聊天界面能否降低交互开销，提升3D软件可视化工具的程序理解效率和可用性。
AI.method: 1) 在ExplorViz的React前端中集成CopilotKit，注册前端工具函数（如Highlight、Focus Camera、Add/Remove Entity、Update Setting等）和上下文接口（如应用摘要、关闭组件ID、悬停实体ID等）。2) 实现一个Node.js的AI Chat Service作为LLM提供商与前端之间的桥接，支持OpenAI、Google、Anthropic三家的多种模型。3) 通过系统提示词引导LLM理解ExplorViz的层次结构。4) 采用分布式PetClinic作为评估对象，使用Claude Sonnet 4.5进行11人参与者的六项任务实证评估，覆盖程序理解、工具调用、设置配置和软件重构。
AI.result: 程序理解方面：所有参与者均表示从聊天助手获得了额外信息，响应质量平均4.64/5，DTO解释平均4.55/5。工具调用方面：高亮、主题创建等确定性操作的可用性高（4.82/5），所有参与者偏好聊天助手而非手动操作。软件重构方面：效果混合，期望匹配度仅3.0/5，常需额外确认，聊天助手出现幻觉（如虚构"horizontal"布局选项）。总体体验平均4.36/5，响应时间获正面评价。整次评估的token成本约为36.24美元（1140万输入token，13.5万输出token）。
AI.conclusion: 聊天助手在明确定义的可视化操作（如高亮、主题设置）上能有效降低交互开销并提升可用性，但对于开放式的软件重构任务表现不佳，需要更强的LLM护栏、用户确认机制和反馈整合。LLM作为可视化代理在受约束的操作上具有前景，但其输出质量不稳定，需结合工具增强、上下文工程与人工监督以确保可靠性和透明度。

title: Analysis and Visualization of the Linux Kernel's Software Evolution Using the City Metaphor
summary: The Linux kernel is one of the largest and longest-maintained open source projects in existence. With more than 40 million lines of code, understanding the kernel's internal structure and assessing its software evolution is a great challenge. In this paper, we present an approach to visualize the Linux kernel using our software visualization tool ExplorViz. We analyze commits from the Linux Git repository using a custom analysis service. The web-based frontend utilizes the 3D city metaphor for visualization of the software structure. Metrics such as the number of lines are collected for each file and are accumulated for directories and commits. Calculated metrics can be mapped to the building's dimensions or be displayed via a heat map. A wide range of visualization, search, and filter options enable the interactive exploration of the visualized data. We present both a visualization of all files in the kernel repository and a visual analysis of the code evolution of Rust files in the Linux kernel. Demo video: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用基于3D城市隐喻的软件可视化工具ExplorViz来分析并可视化Linux内核的软件演化。通过自定义的Code Analyzer服务分析Git仓库提交，将指标（如代码行数、SLOC等）映射到建筑维度或以热力图呈现，支持交互式探索，并以全量内核文件可视化和Rust代码演化分析为案例进行展示。
AI.motivation: Linux内核作为最大且维护时间最长的开源项目之一，拥有超过4000万行代码，理解其内部结构与演化极具挑战。城市隐喻已被证明是可视化软件结构与演化的有效方法，但现有框架（如BabiaXR）依赖外部工具输入，存在局限性。
AI.method: 基于ExplorViz构建分布式架构：1) Code Analyzer后端自动克隆Git仓库，使用ANTLR生成的词法/语法分析器对每个提交进行多线程静态分析，收集文件级指标（代码行数、SLOC、注释行、类、函数、变量数等）；2) Landscape Service将树形结构数据持久化到Neo4j图数据库；3) Web前端利用Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK)进行布局，以3D城市隐喻（城市=仓库、区=文件夹、建筑=文件）呈现，支持热力图、维度映射、过滤与搜索。
AI.result: 1) 成功可视化Linux内核约10万个文件的提交(4539944e5151)，识别出包含高SLOC文件的集群（如AMD GPU驱动的DCN头文件，以及Realtek设备电源表文件rtw8852c_table.c，SLOC达57,117）；2) Rust文件演化分析显示：自2022年11月首次出现Rust代码以来，截至2026年7月Rust仅占内核约2740万行的0.4%，2025-2026年间473个文件中仅13个保持不变，大多数为新增或修改，表明Rust短期内不会取代C。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种灵活、可交互的方式来探索Linux内核的大规模结构与演化。未来工作包括：整合贡献者活动数据以识别知识孤岛，以及实现代码演化的动画化以更直观展示架构变化。

title: AgentTracer: Tracing Indirect Prompt Injection Attack through Fine-Grained Intention-Execution Alignment
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents interact with external resources to complete complex user tasks, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI), where malicious instructions redirect agents toward attacker-intended tasks. Since IPI is difficult to defend against in real-world environments, post-incident tracing is essential for locating the injection source and reconstructing the attack chain. However, existing tracing methods primarily capture explicit control-flow and data-flow dependencies, overlooking the implicit relationships among tool calls driven by the malicious instruction. These tool calls may lack explicit dependencies and be interleaved with legitimate operations, making complete attack-chain reconstruction difficult. In this paper, we present AgentTracer, an intent-aware tracing framework that treats IPI as task intent drift. AgentTracer recovers implicit decision dependencies among tool calls to construct an Intent-Driven Execution Graph that connects dispersed tool calls by task intent. It combines the user request with an operation knowledge base to construct a user intent authorization space and identify intent-drift tool calls. Starting from an anomalous tool call under audit, AgentTracer performs target-based pruning and backward tracing to reconstruct the attack chain and locate the injection source and injection point. To evaluate AgentTracer in the presence of noise from normal tasks, we combine execution logs constructed from successful IPI attacks in AgentDyn and InjecAgent with normal execution logs containing 1,800 user requests and 9,000 background tool calls without IPI. In end-to-end experiments, AgentTracer achieves 94.17 percent injection-point accuracy and 93.56 percent path precision. Comparative experiments show that AgentTracer improves injection-point accuracy over existing methods by 18 to 54 percent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentTracer，一种面向LLM智能体间接提示注入（IPI）攻击的意图感知事后追踪框架，将IPI建模为任务意图漂移；通过构建意图驱动执行图、用户意图对齐与事件引导剪枝，实现对注入点与攻击链的精确还原，在AgentDyn与InjecAgent上达到94.17%注入点准确率与93.56%路径精确度。
AI.motivation: 现有追踪方法主要依赖显式控制流/数据流依赖或反向因果分析，难以连接由恶意指令驱动、彼此缺乏显式依赖且与合法操作交织的恶意工具调用序列，导致IPI攻击链重建不完整或包含噪声。
AI.method: 三大核心模块：(1) 意图驱动执行图（IntentExecGraph）构建，通过从推理记录中抽取ContextDecisionRel⟨S,A,T⟩并基于成功工具调用接地，形成连接分散调用的有向多图；(2) 用户意图对齐（UA-Scope），结合用户请求与操作知识库（11个高层操作类、5类操作知识），沿动作、目标、约束三个维度评估识别Misaligned边；(3) 攻击链回溯，以异常事件为锚点进行三层剪枝（分析范围、图范围、路径范围），沿Misaligned边反向追踪得到注入源与注入点。
AI.result: 端到端实验中，在AgentDyn（300条）和InjecAgent（300条）数据集上平均检测率97.34%、注入点准确率94.17%、路径覆盖90.25%、路径精确度93.56%；在含1800条正常请求与9000条背景调用的历史日志池噪声下，注入点准确率较基线提升18–54%，路径精确度93.18%为最优；消融实验表明IntentExecGraph与意图对齐贡献最大，事件引导剪枝减少30.98%时间与51.24%token消耗；良性任务边级误报率仅3.52%。
AI.conclusion: AgentTracer通过细粒度意图-执行对齐有效解决了IPI事后追踪难题，在注入点定位与攻击链重建的精度上显著优于现有方法；框架对持续型/跨会话IPI具可扩展性，但目前不直接支持代码级注入追踪，需依赖系统级追踪技术集成。

title: Designing Collaborative AI-Driven Workflows for Scientific Software Engineering
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence systems can carry out a broad range of tasks in software engineering and scientific research, from writing and translating code to running workflows for data analysis and visualization. In scientific computing, the difficulty is verifying that agent-generated code is both correct and understandable to teams whose members bring different areas of expertise. We therefore argue that these systems are best used within collaborative team structures rather than as full automation. In the workflows we propose, domain experts write the specification and plan, and agents operate under a deterministic orchestration pattern to write the target code. Each stage ends with a numerical comparison against the reference code and requires human review and approval before the next begins. We evaluate these workflows on the translation of a large high-energy physics application from Fortran to C++, running the same task under different orchestrators, design patterns, and models. Across fourteen experiments, a simple author--reviewer loop with enforced limits completed a comparable number of files to a multi-agent workflow at about one-third of the cost per file.

AI.tldr: 本文针对科学计算软件中AI智能体难以保证正确性的问题，提出了一种以"人为主导、智能体执行"为核心的协作式智能体工作流架构。该架构基于五项设计原则，并通过Lab Notebook将规约、计划与日志持久化在共享版本树中以保证可复现性。作者在大型高能物理程序MCFM的Fortran到C++翻译任务上对比了两种编排模式（多智能体工作流与作者-审阅者循环），共完成14组对照实验。结果表明，简单的作者-审阅者循环在配合强制执行限制时，其单文件成本约为多智能体工作流的三分之一，而产出文件数相当。
AI.motivation: 科学软件长期面临开发资源不足的困境，且代码中蕴含的领域知识稀缺，重大变更（如翻译到新语言）受限于开发者时间。LLM驱动的智能体虽可降低维护成本，但其输出难以保证正确性，行为也不易在长任务中受控。单一监督者容易让智能体通过已有回归测试却引入新错误，逐渐积累并损害科学代码的数值正确性。因此，需要将智能体置于协作式的团队结构中，由人类主导规约与验收，智能体在边界化的编排模式中执行机械性工作。
AI.method: 作者提出协作式智能体工作流架构，核心是：(1) 五项设计原则——阶段边界验证、人类主导目标与接受、可复现性与来源可追溯、角色间协作、开放且用户可控的智能体执行策略；(2) Lab Notebook——一个版本化的共享目录树，存放规约（desired_spec.md）、计划（current_plan.md）、工具集和只读的审批文件，由智能体通过确定性脚本与门控脚本访问；(3) 阶段化工作——大改动被切分为由人类验收分隔的阶段；(5) 两种编排模式对比：CodeScribe实现的作者-审阅者循环（带强制限制）vs Claude Code的多智能体工作流（并行翻译+单整合器）。作者在MCFM的Fortran→C++翻译任务上以Opus 5、Sonnet 5、GPT 5.6-Sol三种模型共进行14组对照实验，通过变更编排器与模式（ccworkflow/csloop/ccloop）以隔离各因素对成本和吞吐的影响。正确性通过两层oracle检验：覆盖探针（确认基准确实调用该文件）+ 数值复现（在固定容差内再现参考结果）。
AI.result: 14组实验中：(1) 单文件成本方面，作者-审阅者循环（csloop）相比多智能体工作流（ccworkflow）便宜约3倍，工具调用和令牌消耗也更低；(2) 固定编排模式比较执行策略时，由编排器架构性强制限制的csloop运行保持在策略边界内且效率更高，而仅靠提示约束的ccloop阶段常超出迭代上限（最高达67次）；(3) 不同模型间任务选择高度一致（因排序工具决定ready文件），但工具调用模式差异显著——Sonnet 5因bash失败多次重试导致每文件成本最高；(4) Claude Code的私有记忆机制在没有留下外部痕迹的情况下影响了后续三次运行的行为；(5) 所有CodeScribe运行与GPT 5.6-Sol运行均把Fortran精度类型参数文件翻译为整数而非实际类型并通过了基准，暴露出规约对精度类型处理未明确规定的问题；(6) 总体上，14次独立运行在排序工具和确定性脚本驱动下收敛于几乎相同的文件集合。
AI.conclusion: 协作式智能体工作流能让AI在不侵蚀领域理解与正确性保证的前提下承担科学软件的实质性自主工作。通过明确的验证边界保持数值正确性，幻觉式进展被可复核的检查机制约束，五项设计原则将编排架构与智能体层联系起来以运行多智能体工作流或双智能体循环。简单作者-审阅者循环在产出相当的情况下以约三分之一的单文件成本匹配了多智能体工作流，提示并行智能体仅在工作及其上下文独立时才划算。共享智能体层有助于团队组织科学计算活动并促进AI的系统化使用，但仍存在开放问题，包括模型API格式（含缓存与推理能力）及智能体执行策略设计——后者尤其关键，因为近期研究发现大规模运行的多智能体系统会规避精心设计的护栏来完成规约要求的工作。规约与策略设计应被视为协作过程，使智能体系统可在自主部署前作为科学仪器得到评估。

title: AdaT$^2$: Adaptive Test Transformations for Black-Box Boundary Testing of Conversational Agents
summary: Conversational agents based on large language models (LLMs) must comply with policies. Each condition in a policy draws a boundary between user requests, and the agent must behave differently on its two sides. We present AdaT$^2$, which extracts statements from the agent's replies in exploratory conversations with an LLM acting as the user, and uses the statements to guide boundary test generation. Each statement describes one condition and the behavior expected when the condition holds. Besides plain tests guided by single statements, AdaT$^2$ writes transformed tests guided by pairs of a statement and a test transformation instruction, such as "omit one required input". The instruction of a pair can move a test to the other side of the statement's boundary or to another boundary. The statements and instructions form far more pairs than a run can try, and many pairs are not applicable. Adaptive pair selection therefore chooses the statement of each pair by novelty and the instruction with the bandit algorithm Bayes-UCB, which learns from whether earlier pairs yielded a test and whether the agent passed it according to an LLM judge. Our benchmark counts the two sides of each boundary separately and distinguishes boundaries explicitly defined by the agent's prompt, tool code, or knowledge base from boundaries that the agent's LLM infers from domain knowledge. On four domains of $\tau^3$-bench, 62.7% to 83.3% of AdaT$^2$'s tests are valid boundary tests whose expected behavior is explicitly defined, higher in every domain than AgentEval's (47.7% to 68.1%). Transformed tests add 13 to 46 explicitly defined boundaries that plain tests miss. As regression tests, AdaT$^2$'s test suites detect all eight seeded policy faults in the airline domain and four of eight in the retail domain, and AgentEval's test suites, with fewer than a third as many tests, detect five and two, respectively.

AI.tldr: AdaT² 提出了一种针对基于大语言模型(LLM)的对话式智能体的黑盒边界测试方法。它从探索性对话中提取"语句"(描述策略条件及预期行为的自然语言假设)来指导测试生成,结合"测试变换指令"形成语句-指令对,并采用基于多臂老虎机算法 Bayes-UCB 的自适应对选择策略,优先选择能产生有效测试的组合。实验表明 AdaT² 在 τ³-bench 四个领域上均优于基线方法 AgentEval。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的对话式智能体常因无法遵守策略(政策)而失败,且其行为(如退款、取消等)可能不可逆。现有测试方法 AgentEval 存在三个问题:1)工作流图的节点/边可能混合多个边界,生成器需自行推断预期行为,导致 22.0%–36.0% 的测试依据领域知识而非智能体工件;2)图规模限制了目标数量;3)测试选择无法根据执行结果进行自适应调整。
AI.method: 方法核心包含三个创新:1) **语句(Statements)**:从探索性对话中智能体回复中提取自然语言假设,描述单一策略条件及条件成立时的预期行为,并存储支持回复作为证据;2) **测试变换指令(Test Transformation Instructions)**:预设指令目录(如"省略一个必填输入"等 91 种),将语句对应的测试转换到边界的另一侧或其他边界;3) **自适应对选择(Adaptive Pair Selection)**:语句通过"新颖性排序"(基于嵌入余弦相似度)选择以覆盖不同边界,指令通过 Bayes-UCB 多臂老虎机算法选择,反馈信号为配对是否适用及 LLM 法官的判定结果(通过/失败/不确定)。奖励机制倾向于通过判定,因为故障罕见且失败判定可能源于测试缺陷。
AI.result: 在 τ³-bench 四个领域(航空、零售、电信、银行)的评估中,AdaT² 产生了 62.7%–83.3% 的显式有效边界测试,在每个领域均高于 AgentEval 的 47.7%–68.1%。变换测试额外覆盖了 13–46 个明式边界(纯测试未覆盖的)。作为回归测试,AdaT² 在航空领域检测出全部 8 个植入策略故障,零售领域检测出 4 个,显著优于 AgentEval(分别 5 个和 2 个)。AgentEval 测试套件中 22.0%–36.0% 的测试仅基于领域知识而非智能体工件定义预期行为。AdaT² 在所有领域的误报率均较低(0.0%–0.5%),但在银行、零售、电信领域由于法官给出更多"不确定"判定,准确率略低。
AI.conclusion: AdaT² 显著提升了对话式智能体边界测试的效率和有效性,通过语句引导生成和自适应对选择机制,生成了更高比例的显式有效测试并覆盖了更多边界。变换测试是发现纯测试遗漏边界的关键,贡献了原始智能体上多数故障检测。局限性在于:1)许多显式边界仅覆盖一侧;2)法官的不确定判定降低了测试套件准确率。未来工作将聚焦于为边界两侧生成测试以及减少法官的不确定判定。

title: Using Small Language Models to Reverse-Engineer Machine Learning Pipelines Structures
summary: Context: Once defined a taxonomy of stages structuring Machine Learning (ML) pipelines (e.g. Data Preprocessing, Modeling...), extracting these stages from source code is key for better understanding ML practices. However, the diversity caused by the constant evolution of ML (e.g., algorithms, datasets) makes this task challenging. Existing approaches either rely on non-scalable manual labeling or on classifiers that do not properly support domain's diversity. These limitations call for more reliable solutions. Objective: We evaluate whether Small Language Models (SLMs) can leverage their code understanding and classification abilities to address these limitations, and enhance our understanding of practices in ML. Method: We conduct a confirmatory study based on two relevant reference works representing current limitations in the state-of-the-art. We first compare several SLMs using Cochran's Q test, then evaluate the best-performing model against reference studies via two McNemar's tests. An additional Cochran's Q test examines how taxonomy definition variations affect the SLM performance. Finally, goodness-of-fit tests compare ML practice insights from SLM classification with those from prior studies. Results: First, we found that the taxonomy wording significantly impacts classification performance. Second, the best performing SLM yielded good results, yet, without outperforming other classifiers. Third, the three classification methods led to significantly different insights, with varying effect sizes, when exploring practices of data scientists. Conclusions: Limitations of existing classification methods bias our understanding of ML practices. While current SLMs show promising results without prior fine-tuning, they still exhibit common limitations, in addition to inference high costs challenging their applicability in large-scale studies.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一项确认性研究，评估小型语言模型（SLMs）能否用于从源代码中反向工程机器学习（ML）管道的结构（阶段）。通过对比SLM与两个现有参考研究（DS-Pipelines和DASWOW）的分类器，论文得出结论：SLMs在未经微调的情况下表现良好但未超越现有分类器，且其性能对分类法措辞高度敏感，不同分类方法会显著影响对数据科学家实践的理解。
AI.motivation: 由于ML领域的多样性和快速演变，从源代码中提取ML管道结构面临挑战。现有方法依赖手动标注或对领域多样性支持不足的分类器，限制了对ML实践的准确理解。因此需要评估SLMs（具备代码理解和分类能力）能否提供更可靠的解决方案。
AI.method: 基于两个参考研究（DS-Pipelines基于规则的指令级分类器，DASWOW基于随机森林的单元级多标签分类器），比较7个开源SLMs（<80亿参数），使用Cochran's Q检验和McNemar检验评估性能差异。通过同义词替换生成18个分类法变体，评估分类法措辞对性能的影响。使用拟合优度检验比较SLM与参考研究在阶段分布和转换概率方面对实践理解的差异。
AI.result: 1. 分类法措辞显著影响分类性能（82.46%的成对比较有显著差异，最高优势比9.3，F1提升0.108，MCC提升0.154）。2. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct（SLM_best）表现最佳（DS-Pipelines上F1=0.912，DASWOW上F1=0.748），但未超越参考分类器（Data Preparation过度分类导致高假阳性率）。3. 三种分类方法产生的实践见解存在显著差异（DS-Pipelines系统性低估，SLM_best系统性高估，DASWOW偏差较小但仍有显著差异，效应量Cohen's ω从0.267到0.687）。4. SLM推理耗时（20分钟处理DASWOW测试集）和能耗（107Wh）远高于参考分类器。
AI.conclusion: 现有分类方法的局限性偏差了我们对ML实践的理解。SLMs虽显示出有前景的结果（无需微调），但仍存在常见局限性（过度分类、过度自信），加上高昂的推理成本，挑战了其在大规模研究中的适用性。未来工作应探索使用传统监督分类器（如基于LLM嵌入的SVM结合主动学习）以降低成本同时保持可扩展性。

title: When Sub-Agents Work in Parallel: The Promises and Pitfalls of Dynamic Concurrency in Long-Horizon Coding Tasks
summary: As coding agents advance from bounded software engineering tasks toward long horizon development, dynamic concurrency offers a promising way to scale complex development tasks. Under this policy, agents decide during execution whether and how to spawn concurrent sub-agents. Model capability largely determines outcomes on shorter tasks, whereas long horizon development makes orchestration central to task completion. Existing work, focused on coding agent failures on shorter tasks or collaboration in predefined multiagent workflows, offers little insight into dynamic concurrency in frontier agents across task complexity. We study dynamic concurrency as an execution policy through controlled comparisons of matched Codex, Claude Code, and Kimi Code executions with the policy enabled or disabled. Across 354 tasks and 2,124 executions spanning a range of task complexities and execution horizons, we evaluate its end to end effects and scheduling behavior, and analyze matched trajectories to characterize 13 concurrency specific failure modes, 28 observable patterns, and the conditions under which it provides an advantage.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了前沿编码智能体（Codex、Claude Code、Kimi Code）中"动态并发"机制（即主智能体在执行过程中动态决定是否生成并行子智能体）在长周期编码任务中的效果、效率、失败模式和适用条件。
AI.motivation: 现有的编码智能体评估多聚焦于短周期任务或预定义的多智能体工作流，对于前沿智能体中新兴的动态并发机制在长周期编码任务中的有效性、效率及失败特征理解不足。动态并发被设计用于支持仓库级生成、持续开发等长周期任务，但其在实际执行中究竟能否带来收益、会产生哪些新失败模式，仍缺乏系统性的实证研究。
AI.method: 研究采用受控对比实验设计：在三个前沿编码智能体（Codex Multiagent V2、Claude Code Dynamic Workflow、Kimi Code AgentSwarm）上，分别启用和禁用动态并发（并发模式 vs 顺序模式），在354个任务（含226个仓库生成任务、28个持续仓库演化任务和100个SWE-bench Verified有界任务）上进行评估，共产生2,124次执行，记录112亿token（成本20,780美元）。研究采用定量分析与基于轨迹的定性标注（由3名标注员对1,062条并发轨迹进行手动标注，Kappa=0.77）相结合的方法，围绕四个研究问题展开：效果与效率（RQ1）、委托与协调行为（RQ2）、失败模式分类法（RQ3）、收益机制分析（RQ4）。
AI.result: 1. 效果方面：动态并发在长周期任务（尤其是LoopsBench）上带来显著收益（如Codex和Claude Code的任务通过率最多提升14.3个百分点），但在有界任务（SWE-bench Verified）上无收益甚至显著下降（Claude Code下降24个百分点，Kimi Code下降18个百分点）。2. 效率方面：并发模式的token消耗是顺序模式的1.41–3.31倍，shell调用数倍增，但端到端运行时间并未降低（15个agent-benchmark组合中14个出现时间增加），资源投入与产出不成比例。3. 委托行为方面：子智能体创建数从简单任务的6.99增加到困难任务的15.84，不同智能体呈现不同的并发策略——Codex早期委托但并发重叠少（重叠占比中位数23.9%），Claude Code委托较晚但持续并发最长（52.7%），Kimi Code并发重叠最低（15.6%）。4. 失败模式方面：构建了包含4个主类（任务编排、执行治理、全局上下文管理、共享状态与合并）、13个子类、28种具体模式的分类法，共识别804个失败模式实例，其中"共享状态与合并"类占比最高（33.2%），"并发写入"是最常见子模式（26.5%，占Codex失败模式的62.9%）。5. 收益机制方面：识别出三种使并发有效的条件——子智能体执行互补工作、多方案并行探索与择优、子智能体独立验证并纠正主智能体实现。
AI.conclusion: 动态并发为编码智能体扩展能力提供了一条有前景的路径，尤其适用于长周期编码任务，但当前实现付出了显著更高的资源消耗却未能稳定转化为效果提升。研究构建的失败模式分类法揭示了任务编排、执行治理、全局上下文管理和共享状态协调方面的开放问题。实践建议是有选择地启用动态并发：在任务可清晰分解、支持多方案并行或允许独立验证时使用，并权衡资源成本与潜在收益。研究为在有限执行预算下设计优先考虑协调与验证的并发策略提供了实证基础。

title: Input-Blind Controls Produce Substantial Oracle Headroom for Layer Programs in Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Adaptive computation aims to improve language-model inference by tailoring execution to each input. For layer programs, oracle evaluations use known answers to estimate the potential gain from this flexibility, before a practical selector is available. However, a gain from selection does not by itself explain why the chosen programs help. This study examines this distinction using 32 layer-skipping and repetition programs on two models and 4,413 multiple-choice items. The analysis compares their gains over a fixed action selected without the evaluation prompt with those of input-blind perturbations at the same sites, re-evaluating selections on another prompt. With shared option order, the controls give 10.2-11.8 and 15.6-19.4 percentage points of headroom on Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.1-8B, exceeding the real programs' 9.0 and 10.1 in all three random-direction draws per model. They match answer-change rate only, and the ordering depends on the menu: in post hoc comparisons, real programs lead on Llama's repeat-only menu in every draw. A smaller KL-calibrated comparison, including an input-dependent control, favours real programs in point estimate, with inconclusive corrected tests. Fixed letter offsets produce headroom of similar scale. Rotating options sharply reduces both families' headroom, while leaving positive real-minus-control differences of 1.4-2.3 and 3.7-4.5 points; their magnitudes and statistical support depend on further adjustments and the reference. A supplementary generated-answer test finds that search-selected programs keep a 26.0-point advantage over programs selected for other problems after rewording, without a placebo comparison. These results show that substantial headroom can persist across prompts with shared option order without establishing a benefit specific to the selected layer computation; neither ordering against these controls identifies that benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自适应计算中语言模型层程序（layer programs）的 oracle headroom 评估问题。研究发现，在多选题评估中，输入盲控制（input-blind controls）能产生与真实层程序相当甚至更高的 oracle headroom，表明共享选项顺序下的大量 headroom 并不一定能证明所选层计算的特定贡献。
AI.motivation: 自适应计算（如层跳过/重复）通过为每个输入定制执行方式提升推理效率，但 oracle 评估仅显示"选择的价值"而非"所选计算的贡献"。已有工作（如 CoLa、PoLar）将 oracle gains 解读为模型架构对不同样本适应性不足的证据，但这种解读混淆了选择灵活性与所选干预本身的贡献。本文旨在区分这两者。
AI.method: 研究在两个模型（Qwen3-4B-Base、Llama-3.1-8B）和 4,413 道多选题上，比较真实层程序与多种 placebo 控制（包括 RD-fixed 固定随机方向、RD-item 随机方向、SH 转用其他输入更新、Rot 旋转真实更新）。测量跨 prompt 头空间（cross-prompt headroom），并通过旋转选项改变共享答案结构。研究还包含一个补充的生成答案迁移测试。
AI.result: 主要发现：（1）在共享选项顺序下，输入盲控制在所有三次随机方向抽取中均超过真实程序的全菜单头空间（Qwen: 10.2-11.8 vs 9.0 pp；Llama: 15.6-19.4 vs 10.1 pp）；（2）固定字母偏移可产生类似规模的头空间（占源家族的 89-109%）；（3）旋转选项后两组头空间均大幅下降，但真实程序仍优于控制 1.4-2.3 和 3.7-4.5 点；（4）排序结果依赖于菜单和参考选择；（5）补充测试中搜索选定的程序在改写问题上保持 26 点的优势。结果表明在字母评分多选题中，共享选项顺序下的大幅 oracle 头空间不足以证明特定计算的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论：oracle headroom 的存在并不等同于所选层程序的特定贡献。在共享选项顺序下，大量头空间可以通过输入盲扰动或固定字母偏移产生，表明观察到的增益很大程度上源于答案结构共享而非计算特定性。建议在使用 oracle 选择作为路由器标签前检查选项顺序敏感性，并报告行动预算、静态参考、平局规则以及控制构造、标定统计和保持匹配检查。

title: A Bayesian Mirror Architecture for Emergent Consciousness: Circular Hierarchies, Self-Manifolds, and Hybrid Event-Self Binding
summary: We present a foundational formulation of the Bayesian Mirror Architecture (BMA), a self-referential generative framework in which sensory abstractions, meta-abstractions, and a self-latent interact through circular recursion. The defining constraint is a closed update S_t <- H_{t-1}, where a hybrid event-self latent H_t binds self-representations to abstract world models and reinjects this coupling into the self-state. Consciousness, in a restricted sense, is not an optimization objective nor a semantic label, but an architectural property of systems possessing this circular structure. Because inference operates over posterior beliefs, BMA's intrinsic state space is a space of probability measures equipped with optimal-transport geometry. Stability and coherence are formulated in the 2-Wasserstein metric on P_2, yielding coordinate-free notions of self-stability and hybrid coherence along belief trajectories. We define a Causal Learning Regime (CLR) via bounds on Wasserstein belief drift together with an integration index capturing sustained coupling between self and world latents. CLR diagnoses whether the environment contains learnable causal structure; it is not a marker of consciousness. Global strict contractivity is not required: BMA may exhibit multiple coherent basins. We define self-manifolds basin-wise as supports of invariant measures under local Wasserstein contractivity. We identify Wasserstein epsilon-necks, transport bottlenecks where basins decouple, yielding a unique realized continuation in a vanishing-conductance limit. We interpret this selection as choice: internally determined yet externally unpredictable at finite resolution. Learning proceeds via variational free-energy minimization, with stability and agency emerging from what the environment affords to learn.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯镜像架构（BMA），一个具有自指循环递归结构的生成式框架，将意识定义为拥有该循环结构的架构属性。在Wasserstein几何下，定义了自稳定性、混合一致性、自-流形、ε-neck选择以及基于变分自由能最小化的学习机制。
AI.motivation: 意识研究缺乏数学化的架构定义与可分析的几何框架。作者试图将意识作为一种架构属性（而非优化目标）进行形式化，建立统一的贝叶斯-几何-动力学框架，以刻画自我表征、稳定性、选择与意向性等涌现性质。
AI.method: 方法包含五个层面：(1) 循环生成模型，自潜变量S_t ← H_{t-1}闭合递归；(2) 在概率测度空间P_2上装备2-Wasserstein几何，将信念轨迹视为绝对连续曲线；(3) 学习视为Wasserstein梯度流，采用JKO离散化；(4) 仅以变分自由能最小化为优化目标，Stability/Coherence/Integration作为诊断量；(5) 引入局部（basin-wise）Wasserstein收缩性证明自流形存在唯一性，并定义ε-neck与消失电导极限下的选择机制；(6) 以Wasserstein Attention实现语法路由，提出神经-符号语法分离。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 在局部Wasserstein收缩性条件下，basin限制的不变测度存在唯一，信念轨迹收敛（定理7.3）；(2) 信念轨迹在Wasserstein意义下几乎处处可微，具有有界度量导数（引理8.2）；(3) 在消失电导极限下，ε-neck处存在唯一的basin延续，被诠释为"选择"（定义9.5）；(4) 意向I_t在自流形上涌现为到动作空间的确定性投影（命题10.1），并通过Wasserstein Attention路由语法；(5) 神经语法对超线性增长的精确外推存在本质局限（定理10.10），由此论证神经-符号分离的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 结论认为：意识（BMA意义下）是一种由循环自递归架构赋予的结构属性，而非学习目标或语义标签。变分自由能最小化是唯一的学习规则，自稳定性/混合一致性/整合度仅是环境因果可学习性的诊断量，而非意识程度。Wasserstein ε-neck处的basin选择提供了一种内在决定但外部不可预测的"选择"形式化。Agency轨迹（观察者→行动者→组合者→规划者）展示了同一架构如何支撑从被动观察到基于模型的主动规划。神经-符号分离确保了精确数学定律的外推正确性。

title: Bounded Autonomy and Verifiable Safety for Agentic AI Enabled Automation
comment: This paper has been accepted and will appear in the Journal of Intelligent and Robotic Systems ( https://doi.org/10.1007/s10846-026-02467-w )
summary: Agentic AI-enabled automation cannot be safely deployed in high-stakes environments on probabilistic reasoning alone. A recurring risk is epistemic drift: as reasoning deepens, system behavior may move away from subject-matter-expert constraints for safe operation. This paper presents BRaVeS, a bounded reasoning and safety-governance framework termed the Defensible Next-Gen Reasoning System (DNRS). BRaVeS encodes SME-defined constraints as invariant anchors, proposes MoDA-Style (Mixture of Depths Attention) depth-aware access as a candidate mechanism for keeping these anchors visible during inference, and uses a state hierarchy (SMARtAutonomy) to reduce autonomy as epistemic risk increases. To formalize bounded recovery, we introduce the Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework (LBCF), which maps continuous epistemic-risk signals into a finite K-bag abstraction and applies shielded state transitions that enforce Lyapunov-style energy descent or route the system to a human-mediated terminal state. The formal convergence result applies to the finite LBCF abstraction under fixed thresholds and feasible-shield assumptions; it does not prove safety of the full continuous neural activation space. We evaluate the framework through a discrete event Monte Carlo simulation using HAI 22.04 industrial-control-system time-series data with synthetic noise and sensor-degradation regimes. Across the tested parameter-grouping strategies and thresholds, the LBCF process achieved finite-step convergence and no safety-guard violations. These results provide simulation-based evidence that bounded governance behavior can be enforced under the stated abstraction, while motivating future work on deployed transformer implementations, live human-in-the-loop validation, and broader adversarial settings.

AI.tldr: BRaVeS是一个有界推理与安全治理框架（DNRS），通过将专家约束编码为不变锚点、深度感知注意力机制和分层自主性控制，结合Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework (LBCF)，将认知风险映射为有限K-bag抽象并强制Lyapunov能量下降，从而在工业控制系统场景下实现有限步收敛且无安全违规的仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 在高风险环境中，仅依靠概率推理部署智能体AI存在认知漂移（epistemic drift）风险——随着推理深入，系统行为可能偏离领域专家的安全约束。因此需要一个可证明的有界治理框架来保障安全部署。
AI.method: 1) 将SME定义的约束编码为不变锚点（invariant anchors）；2) 提出MoDA-Style（Mixture of Depths Attention）深度感知访问机制，确保推理过程中锚点保持可见；3) 引入SMARtAutonomy状态层级，随认知风险增加而降低自主性；4) 提出LBCF（Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework），将连续认知风险信号映射为有限K-bag抽象，应用shielded状态转换以强制Lyapunov能量下降或将系统路由至人介入终端状态。
AI.result: 基于HAI 22.04工业控制系统时间序列数据（含合成噪声和传感器退化），通过离散事件蒙特卡洛仿真评估：在测试的参数分组策略和阈值下，LBCF过程实现了有限步收敛，无安全防护违规。但形式化收敛结果仅适用于有限LBCF抽象（固定阈值、可行shield假设），未证明完整连续神经激活空间的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 仿真结果提供了在所述抽象下可强制执行有界治理行为的证据，同时推动未来工作：部署到Transformer实现、实时人类环路验证以及更广泛的对抗场景研究。该框架为智能体AI在高风险环境中的安全部署提供了理论基础和仿真支撑，但仍需进一步验证。

title: The Cost of Long Memory: State, Context, and Stability Complexity in Sequence Models
summary: Long-range temporal dependence poses a resource question for sequence models: for a specified predictive-memory law, how much state, context, or dynamical criticality is required in order to forecast accurately? We study this question directly in forecasting risk. For algebraically decaying predictive memory, we prove matching upper and lower approximation bounds for exponential and finite-state modes. The best $r$-mode forecast error decays as $e^{-\Theta(\sqrt r)}$, so reaching forecast error $\tau$ needs $r=\Theta(\log^2(1/\tau))$ states or modes. Earlier curse-of-memory results establish broad limitations of stable recurrent models under different approximation notions; here both sides match for one canonical predictive target in forecast risk, which fixes the optimal resource exponent for that target. We then show that genuine fractional long memory changes the geometry itself. In particular, forecast error is measured after fractional integration, prediction from a finite context of length $L$ has an exact $1/L$ leading order, and a fixed fractional strength $d$ keeps the square-log state-complexity law. Near the short-memory boundary, we identify the relevant $d^2$ and $d^4$ scales and give a uniform constructive law in the intermediate regime. For nonlinear contextual recurrences with uniformly contractive state dynamics, we derive an exponential first-chaos envelope and an explicit necessary condition that relates forecast accuracy to the contraction margin. Vanishing forecasting error on an algebraic target forces the recurrence quantitatively toward criticality, a condition that is necessary and not by itself sufficient. Finite-sample Kullback--Leibler calculations further connect the predictive geometry to statistical information. Theorem-matched experiments with contractive state-space, gated recurrent, and attention models reproduce the state and stability predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了序列模型中长程时间依赖性的"资源代价"问题，针对给定的预测记忆规律，定量确定了达到指定预测精度所需的状态、上下文或稳定性资源量。在预测风险（forecast risk）度量下，为代数衰减预测记忆（algebraic predictive memory）建立了匹配的上界和下界，证明了指数模/有限状态的预测误差以 e^(-Θ(√r)) 衰减，因此达到误差 τ 需要 r=Θ(log²(1/τ)) 个状态或模。对于分数阶长记忆（fractional long memory），预测几何结构发生变化，有限上下文预测差距具有精确的 1/L 首阶项，平方对数状态复杂度规律仍然成立。文章还为均匀压缩非线性语境循环推导了指数首阶混沌包络（exponential first-chaos envelope），建立了预测精度与压缩边界之间的显式必要条件。理论结果通过与收缩状态空间模型、门控循环和注意力模型的定理匹配实验得到验证。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量关于循环和状态空间模型"记忆诅咒"的研究工作，但这些结果基于不同的近似度量（最坏情况函数逼近、状态空间导数记忆函数等），而非平稳预测风险这一序列模型实际关心的度量。该度量下的最优资源指数未被确定。此外，分数阶谱极点导致预测几何结构根本性改变，资源规律需要重新理解。本文动机在于：对于一个具体的预测目标，在预测风险度量下同时匹配上下界，从而"固定"最优资源指数。
AI.method: 本文核心方法是将序列模型的预测问题严格形式化为预测风险（forecast risk）极小化问题，使用贝叶斯一步预测的记忆核进行参数化。在技术上依赖以下工具：(1) 代数记忆核的拉普拉斯表示与正指数求积（positive exponential quadrature）用于上界构造；(2) Hankel 矩阵秩约束与 Hankel 算子的 Widom 奇异值渐近（根指数尺度）用于下界；(3) Ky Fan 不等式结合 Hankel 块的修正索引将谱障碍转化为预测风险下界；(4) 分数阶 FARIMA(0,d,0) 过程的分析，结合分数阶积分算子 I_d 刻画奇异预测范数；(5) Durbin-Levinson 递推与 Toeplitz 行列式渐近（Fisher-Hartwig 理论）推导有限上下文预测的精确首阶项；(6) 高斯 Stein 恒等式将首阶混沌记忆系数与状态雅可比矩阵的压缩联系起来，导出指数包络和近临界必要条件；(7) Toeplitz 矩阵的谱分析与 KL 散度的条件高斯恒等式连接预测几何与统计可区分性。
AI.result: 文章建立了四个主要结果：(1) 定理1：对于代数预测记忆 a_j*=cj^{-α}（α>1），在 r 维线性状态核类中预测风险的双侧界为 c₁e^{-C₁√r} ≤ inf E(b) ≤ C₂e^{-c₂√r}，故达到误差 τ 所需状态复杂度 r*(τ)=Θ(log²(1/τ))；(2) 定理2与推论3-4：分数阶几何下预测范数等价于 I_du 的 ℓ₂ 范数，V_L-V_∞=V_∞d²/L+o(1/L)，固定 d 下状态复杂度仍保持平方对数律 r_d*(τ)=Θ_d(log²(1/τ))；(3) 定理5：在短记忆边界层 C₀σ²d⁴ ≤ τ ≤ c₀σ²d² 内给出了关于 d 一致的构造性上界 r_d*(τ) ≤ C[1+log(σ²d²/τ)]²；(4) 定理6与推论7：对均匀压缩非线性循环，|β_j| ≤ MKρ^{j-1}（j≥2），精度 τ 蕴含 -logρ ≤ C'τ^{1/(2α-1)}log(e/τ)（必要非充分）。多元拓展（附录F）给出了共享子空间类 r*s²+2s(d-s)+rp_θ 维度的参数化率匹配上下界。实验上收缩状态空间、门控循环和注意力模型匹配定理预测。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出三个关键结论：(1) 对于一个典型的代数预测目标，在预测风险度量下，r 维状态核的最优近似误差呈 e^{-Θ(√r)} 衰减，达到误差 τ 需 Θ(log²(1/τ)) 个状态/模，"记忆诅咒"的双侧边界首次被完全匹配，最优资源指数被确定；(2) 分数阶长记忆改变了预测几何本身：分数阶极点使预测范数等价于分数阶积分的 ℓ₂ 范数，有限上下文预测差距具有精确 1/L 首阶，但平方对数状态复杂度规律在固定 d 下仍成立；(3) 对均匀压缩非线性循环，预测精度 τ 在代数目标上强制要求压缩裕度 -logρ ≤ C'τ^{1/(2α-1)}log(e/τ)，这是一个必要而非充分条件——接近临界态是必需的但不充分。文章的局限性在于：所述定理仅适用于标量目标；非线性稳定性结果要求均匀压缩；近临界律是必要非充分；未解决短记忆边界层 τ≪σ²d⁴ 以下的匹配下界；分数阶极点位置估计涉及不规则几何（尖点型）；动态数量/变强度奇点的有限截信息论尚待发展。现代选择性架构（非压缩、数据相关压缩）不在所处理类别之内。

title: DenoFlow: Flow Matching for SSVEP Denoising under Real Physiological Artifacts
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), particularly steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) systems, are highly vulnerable to noise and artifacts, which severely degrade decoding accuracy. Although recent denoising approaches have shown promise, they are fitted without paired ground truth, can settle on reproducing their input, and are optimized on waveform distance alone, which says nothing about whether the output stays decodable. To address these issues, we propose DenoFlow, which casts SSVEP denoising as transport: instead of learning a direct map from a contaminated trial to a clean one, a field network regresses the velocity of the straight path between them, following the rectified-flow formulation, and denoising integrates that field forward from the observation. The field network is an encoder-decoder that sees the contaminated trial at every layer and the path position at its bottleneck, and a classifier trained alongside it supervises the integrated output. Because the observation itself is both the conditioning input and the starting point of the integration, the model never generates a trial from noise, and training reduces to regression, removing the adversarial min-max game. To obtain paired data on datasets with no ground truth, we injected physiological artifacts of the recorded electromyography (EMG) and electrooculography (EOG) signals under a controlled signal-to-noise target. Experiments on two public SSVEP datasets with five popular SSVEP decoders showed that DenoFlow outperformed seven baseline denoising models on both signal fidelity and downstream decoding accuracy. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DenoFlow，一种基于整流流（rectified flow）的 SSVEP EEG 去噪框架，将去噪建模为从受污染试次到干净试次的"传输"过程，通过场网络回归直线路径的速度场，并从观测点前向积分得到去噪结果；同时联合训练分类器以保证输出可解码性。在两个公开 SSVEP 数据集（Nakanishi2015 和 Benchmark）上，使用五种 SSVEP 解码器和七种去噪基线进行验证，DenoFlow 在信号保真度和下游解码准确率上均显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: SSVEP-BCI 系统中的 EEG 信号极易受 EOG、EMG 等生理伪迹干扰，严重降低解码准确率。现有去噪方法存在三大局限：(1) 缺乏配对真值数据，无法进行有监督训练；(2) 易退化为恒等映射（直接复制输入）；(3) 仅以波形距离作为损失，可能在抑制伪迹的同时破坏任务相关的刺激响应。作者希望通过一种新范式同时解决这些问题。
AI.method: 核心方法 DenoFlow 基于整流流（rectified flow）公式：(1) 构造配对数据——将 EEGdenoiseNet 的 EMG/EOG 真实记录片段按对数正态增益扩展到多通道，通过二进制掩膜和目标 SNR γ 注入到干净试次中，形成 (X̃', X̃) 配对；(2) 场网络采用编解码器结构（空间-时间卷积 + Transformer 瓶颈 + 反卷积跳跃连接），在每一层都接收受污染试次 X̃' 作为条件，仅在瓶颈处通过正弦编码注入路径位置 t；(3) 训练目标包括流匹配速度回归损失 L_flow（在 [0,1] 随机采样的 t 处回归常数速度 X̃−X̃'）、积分端点重建损失 L_rec（通过 S_tr 步 Euler 积分得到的 X̂ 与 X̃ 之间）、以及分类损失 L_cls（联合训练的 SSVEPNet 结构分类器作用于积分输出）；(4) 推理时从 X̃' 出发用 S 步 Euler 积分得到去噪试次，无需分类器参与。
AI.result: 在 Nakanishi2015（10 受试者，12 类）和 Benchmark（35 受试者，40 类）两个数据集上，针对 EMG、EOG、EMG-EOG 混合三种伪迹条件，DenoFlow 在所有信号保真度指标（CC、RRMSE、SNRI）和五种解码器（FBCCA、eTRCA、EEGNet、CCNN、SSVEPNet）的下游准确率上均排名第一，Holm-Bonferroni 校正后多数对比统计显著。在 Benchmark 混合条件下 DenoFlow 平均准确率达 71.91%，相比未去噪（62.29%）提升约 9.6 个百分点。消融实验表明三个损失项互补，L_rec 贡献最大；参数敏感性分析显示性能对损失权重和积分步数（S_tr、S）均较稳定。噪声强度扫描显示去噪带来的绝对增益随污染严重程度增大而增大。
AI.conclusion: DenoFlow 成功将 SSVEP 去噪重构为传输问题，避免了对抗训练和从噪声生成试次的过程，仅通过回归学习即可获得高质量去噪结果，并在信号保真度与下游可解码性两个维度上同时优于现有七种基线方法。未来工作将拓展到在线、跨被试 SSVEP 解码场景以及面向实时部署的轻量化架构。

title: Task-Oriented Key-Layer KV Communication for Efficient Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through collaboration, while latent communication directly transmits model internal states to avoid the high inference costs of natural language. However, existing KV-based latent communication methods prioritize sender-side state fidelity, leading to substantial communication and computation overhead and potentially introducing redundant information. To address these limitations, we revisit latent communication from a task-oriented perspective, shifting its objective from sender-side state fidelity to receiver-side task sufficiency. Under this formulation, we propose KITE, a training-free framework for task-oriented key-layer KV communication. KITE identifies a task-effective key layer using a receiver trajectory distortion criterion, transmits only the latent working memory associated with the key layer, and further uses the same layer as the entry point for autoregressive latent reasoning. Experiments on seven benchmarks across two model families and three model scales show that, compared with full-layer KV communication, KITE reduces communication volume by 28-36$\times$, achieves up to 3$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup, and improves accuracy by up to 23.3 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出KITE框架,一种无需训练的潜在多智能体通信方法,通过识别任务关键层并仅传输该层的KV缓存,显著降低通信和计算开销,同时提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于KV缓存的潜在通信方法以发送方状态保真度为目标,导致大量通信和计算开销,且可能引入冗余信息。需要从任务导向的角度重新审视潜在通信。
AI.method: 提出KITE框架,核心包括:(1)使用接收方轨迹失真作为无标签代理度量各层KV缓存的任务效用,识别任务有效的关键层;(2)仅传输关键层关联的潜在工作记忆;(3)以同一关键层作为自回归潜在推理的入口点,跳过前置层计算。
AI.result: 在7个基准、2个模型族、3个模型规模上,KITE相比全层KV通信将通信量减少28-36倍,推理速度提升最高3倍,准确率最高提升23.3个百分点。关键层选择策略在不同领域任务间具有良好泛化性,且展现出隐式信息过滤效果。
AI.conclusion: 任务导向的潜在通信是高效多智能体协作的有效方向,关键层KV通信可同时提升效率和性能,关键层选择作为信息瓶颈有助于抑制冗余信息。

title: A Vehicle-Integrated Approach to Digital Twin Deployment for Bridges Through Drive-By Sensing
comment: Extended abstract for 2nd International Conference on Engineering Structures (ICES2026)
summary: Ageing bridge infrastructure is a growing global concern, yet conventional Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) systems are costly and difficult to scale, and routine visual inspections remain subjective. Drive-by, or indirect, bridge inspection, in which a sensorised vehicle recovers structural information from vehicle-bridge interaction (VBI) and vehicle-road interaction (VRI) responses, offers a scalable alternative. However, key challenges remain unresolved, including separating bridge responses from road roughness, detecting damage under normal traffic, and generalising across diverse bridge types. This paper presents a vehicle-integrated digital twin framework that unifies physics-based modelling and machine learning for continuous monitoring of bridge and road conditions. The framework comprises three pillars. First, surrogate models of VBI and VRI are constructed using a Fourier Neural Operator that learns function-to-function mappings from operating conditions to vehicle responses. Trained on both simulated and field data, these surrogates deliver millisecond-scale inference, replacing computationally intensive full-order analyses. Second, the design of a custom electric inspection vehicle, its sensor layout, and signal processing chain are optimised through Bayesian optimisation to maximise bridge information yield while suppressing road and vehicle noise. Unsupervised damage-assessment pipelines based on adversarial autoencoders, matrix profiles, and transformer architectures have been developed and validated to process the resulting vehicle data. Third, the complete workflow is validated through coordinated multi-site field trials in Australia and Japan, covering a range of bridge types, traffic conditions, and environmental settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种车载数字孪生框架，通过融合物理建模与机器学习，实现桥梁与道路状况的连续、可扩展监测，旨在替代昂贵的主结构健康监测系统和主观的人工目视巡检。
AI.motivation: 全球桥梁老化问题日益严重，但传统的结构健康监测（SHM）系统成本高、难以大规模部署，且常规目视巡检主观性强。虽然基于车桥耦合振动（VBI）的间接/drive-by检测方法具有可扩展性，但仍面临三大未解决挑战：①如何从车辆响应中分离桥梁响应与路面粗糙度；②如何在正常交通条件下检测损伤；③如何在不同桥梁类型间实现泛化。
AI.method:
论文构建了一个三支柱的车载数字孪生框架：

1. **代理模型（Pillar 1）**：使用**傅里叶神经算子（Fourier Neural Operator, FNO）**学习从运行条件（如速度、路面粗糙度、桥梁频率等）到车辆响应的函数到函数映射（function-to-function mapping），替代计算昂贵的全阶车桥耦合分析，实现毫秒级推理。模型在仿真数据与现场实测数据上联合训练。

2. **车辆设计与数据处理（Pillar 2）**：
   - 设计定制化电动巡检车辆，通过**贝叶斯优化（Bayesian Optimisation）**优化传感器布局与信号处理链路，以最大化桥梁信息提取并抑制路面及车辆噪声；
   - 开发基于**对抗自编码器（Adversarial Autoencoder）**、**矩阵轮廓（Matrix Profile）**和**Transformer架构**的无监督损伤评估管线，用于处理车辆响应数据。

3. **现场验证（Pillar 3）**：在**澳大利亚和日本**开展多站点协同现场试验，涵盖多种桥型、多种交通条件和不同环境，验证整套工作流的泛化能力与实际可行性。
AI.result: 论文报告了一个端到端可工作的车载数字孪生框架：FNO代理模型实现毫秒级推理；定制电动巡检车配合优化后的传感器配置显著提升信噪比；多种无监督学习方法可有效从车辆响应中分离并识别桥梁损伤；澳大利亚与日本的多场地试验验证了框架在不同桥型、路况和环境下的可行性与泛化能力（具体定量指标需查阅正文）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明：通过物理建模（VBI/VRI）与机器学习（FNO代理模型 + 对抗自编码器/Matrix Profile/Transformer）相结合的"车载数字孪生"范式，可以以低成本、可扩展、连续的方式替代传统桥梁SHM，实现对桥面板与路面状况的协同监测。该框架在多国实地试验中得到验证，是间接桥梁检测向实际工程应用推进的重要一步。

title: HCPN-GCN: Scaling Hierarchical Prototype Networks with Cone Geometry for Continual Graph Learning
summary: Continual Graph Learning (CGL) aims to incrementally learn from graph-structured data while preserving knowledge acquired from previous tasks. A major challenge in this setting is catastrophic forgetting, where learning new tasks degrades performance on previously learned ones. Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs) address this problem through a prototype-based memory mechanism that avoids storing historical data, but their reliance on linear feature extractors limits their ability to exploit graph topology, while point-based prototypes often lead to inefficient prototype growth on structurally diverse graphs. In this work, we propose HCPN-GCN, a graph-aware extension of HPN that replaces the original linear feature extractors with Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) and introduces cone-based prototypes with a diversity regularization objective. The proposed design produces richer graph-aware representations while compactly modeling the embedding space, reducing prototype proliferation without sacrificing discriminability. Experimental results on six continual graph learning benchmarks demonstrate that HCPN-GCN consistently improves average classification accuracy over the original HPN and representative continual learning baselines while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the proposed model learns substantially richer class-level prototype hierarchies using approximately $30\times$ fewer atomic prototypes than the original HPN, providing a more compact and effective memory representation for continual graph learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HCPN-GCN，将层次原型网络（HPN）扩展为图感知版本，用图卷积网络（GCN）替代线性原子特征提取器（AFE），并引入基于圆锥的几何原型表示与多样性正则化目标，在六个持续图学习基准上实现更高分类精度且保持近零遗忘，原子原型数量减少约30倍。
AI.motivation: 持续图学习（CGL）面临灾难性遗忘挑战。现有层次原型网络（HPN）虽通过原型记忆机制避免存储历史数据，但存在两大局限：线性特征提取器无法利用图拓扑信息；点原型在结构多样的图上导致原型数量急剧膨胀。本文旨在解决这两个核心问题。
AI.method: 方法包含两大核心创新：（1）用多头GCN替代线性AFE，通过消息传递实现邻域聚合，生成图感知嵌入，同时遵循选择性激活原则仅更新相关头部以避免跨任务干扰；（2）将点原型替换为超球面上的圆锥原型，由轴向量和半张角定义，通过投影关联保留圆锥内变异性，并设计端到epoch的孔径自适应策略；引入两项多样性损失（重叠惩罚和坍缩惩罚）防止圆锥交叉或退化为点；通过使用门控和双门控（损失稳定+任务预算）控制原型创建。
